title: 'Cowboy Boots' A Short Film by CSU Alum Eric Delehoy to Premiere at Lyric Theater in Ft. Collins
description: 'Cowboy Boots,' by Eric Delehoy, explores the theme of finding one's place in the world through the experiences of Jack, a gay farm boy, who drifts into a gay club in San Francisco. The [...]
content:
Photo by Ann H: https://www.pexels.com/photo/lens-of-movie-projector-5515483/
' Cowboy Boots ,' by Eric Delehoy, explores the theme of finding one's place in the world through the experiences of Jack, a gay farm boy, who drifts into a gay club in San Francisco. The 10-minute film will have its first screening at the Lyric Theater in Ft. Collins on August 24. This is Delehoy's debut film.
'As a Colorado State alumnus with deep ties to the school and the area's queer community, it was important for me to make Ft. Collins the first site this work will be screened,' said Delehoy. 'Over the last few decades, I have received strong support from the queer community in the area and want to thank them all for helping me find my voice.'
Delehoy graduated from CSU in 1995 and also served as Executive Director of the Lambda Community Center, a non-profit queer community center serving northern Colorado/southern Wyoming, and later as President of the Board of that organization.
'Cowboy Boots' explores the intersection of accepting one's sexual identity and trying to find the community in which it can reside. It is at once a dive into the longings and desires of a young, rural gay man and the realities of being a newcomer in a world that he doesn't know or understand. While the story is queer in nature, the themes of finding one's place, and the discomfort that comes along with doing so, are universal. 'Cowboy Boots' was originally published in 2005 as a short story in Instant City: A Literary Exploration of San Francisco.
The screening will take place at 2:00 pm on Saturday, August 24 at the Lyric Theater in Ft. Collins. It will be followed by a talk-back session with Delehoy and the two principal actors, Michael Ridley and Evan Halpert. A reception will follow. Tickets are $8.00 and are available here: Cowboy Boots (lyriccinema.com)

title: How to Find The Top Outpatient Programs for Speedy Recovery
description: Selecting the right outpatient program plays a crucial role in the recovery of individuals dealing with addiction or mental health challenges. With a plethora of choices available nowadays, navigating…
content:
NORTH FORTY NEWS FILE PHOTO
Selecting the right outpatient program plays a crucial role in the recovery of individuals dealing with addiction or mental health challenges. With a plethora of choices available nowadays, navigating these programs can be quite daunting. This article will delve into techniques for identifying and choosing top-tier outpatient programs that offer the support and resources essential for a successful recovery journey. 1. Conducting Program Research
Conducting research is key to finding outpatient programs in Orange County or anywhere else. Begin by exploring platforms that provide comprehensive details about various programs in your locality. These platforms often feature reviews and ratings from participants or their families, offering valuable insights into others' experiences.
Another valuable resource for program evaluation is communities and forums dedicated to addiction or mental health recovery. Engaging with these communities enables you to connect with individuals who have gone through journeys and receive recommendations on effective programs they may have participated in. 2. Streamlining Your Choices
Once you have gathered information on outpatient programs, it's time to streamline your options. When choosing an outpatient program, it's important to consider factors like location, ease of access, program organization, the ratio of patients to staff, available specialties (such as dual diagnosis treatment), types of therapy offered (individual and group therapy) aftercare services, and insurance acceptance. 3. Evaluating Program Effectiveness
To determine the effectiveness of a program, it's essential to inquire about success rates and outcome measures used by each facility. Reputable treatment centers will willingly provide this information to clients. Success rates may include indicators such as duration of sobriety or improvement in health symptoms.
In addition to outcome statistics, it is advisable to look into the qualifications and certifications of staff members at the facility, such as any licensing or accreditation from relevant governing bodies in the fields of addiction treatment or mental health. These accreditations demonstrate that the facility upholds standards of care. 4. Seeking Professional Advice
Seeking advice from a healthcare professional specializing in addiction medicine or mental health can offer guidance in choosing a quality outpatient program. These experts are familiar with programs in your area and can tailor their recommendations to suit your individual needs and situation. Moreover, they can assess any conditions that may necessitate specialized attention.
When healthcare professionals recommend outpatient programs, they seek adherence to evidence-based practices, inclusive treatment plans, and a holistic approach to recovery. 5. Visiting the Facility
Touring the facility to get a feel of its environment, staff dynamics, amenities, and overall vibe is crucial. During the visit, evaluate each program based on criteria to determine which best aligns with your needs. This visit also allows you to ask any lingering questions that still need to be addressed. 6. Finding Peer Support
Connecting with peers can be incredibly valuable during addiction or mental health recovery journeys. Look for support groups tailored to your situation where you can bond with others facing struggles. Group members often share insights on their experiences with outpatient programs, helping you make a well-informed choice. 7. Exploring Financial Options
Before committing to an outpatient program, explore the financing options for these services. Contact the facility and seek advice from an expert to understand insurance coverage eligibility, payment plans, and potential financial aid programs offered by local entities. 8. Assessing Holistic Approach
When assessing outpatient programs, it's crucial to look at their treatment approach. Seek programs that address not only the side but also focus on the emotional, social, and spiritual aspects of recovery. Effective programs often blend therapy methods, like behavioral therapy, mindfulness practices, family counseling , and trauma-informed care. 9. Considering Relapse Prevention Strategies
In terms of preventing relapse, it's essential to find outpatient facilities that incorporate strategies for relapse prevention into their treatment plans. Techniques backed by evidence, such as creating relapse prevention strategies with triggers and coping mechanisms promoting attendance at support group meetings like Alcoholics Anonymous or Narcotics Anonymous and teaching skills to combat cravings, play a role in helping individuals sustain sobriety and manage their mental well-being effectively. Conclusion
To discover the best outpatient program for recovery, one must conduct thorough research and carefully evaluate options while seeking guidance from professionals and peers. Factors such as location, effectiveness metrics, and financial aspects should be considered. By following these thoughts, individuals can choose an outpatient program tailored to their needs that offers care throughout their journey toward overcoming addiction or mental health challenges.

title: Watering During the Dog Days
description: By Indigo Deany | Fort Collins Nursery Welcome August – welcome heat waves, fiery air, crispy edges, languid and listless stirrings. This is the solar season, where the smoldering sun bests even the…
content:
Watering (Photo by Olya Harytovich, Pexels.com)
By Indigo Deany | Fort Collins Nursery
Welcome August – welcome heat waves, fiery air, crispy edges, languid and listless stirrings. This is the solar season, where the smoldering sun bests even the most committed and enthusiastic gardeners. One of the many lessons of gardening is to listen to what the world around us is saying, even when it's hissing at us to stay inside, human, your roots are not deep enough to withstand this heat . Plants, on the other hand, have the advantage. With their roots able to reach deep into the cool, dark earth, they are able to weather this midsummer heat, as long as we give them support. In Colorado, we all know that water is precious, scarce, and expensive. So how do we get the most from it while keeping our gardens alive in this dry, summer heat?
There are multiple methods of using water efficiently in your garden that are, these days, conventional wisdom. They bear repeating because they work: mulch your beds, use a drip system if you can, water during the early morning or evening, and collect water in a rain barrel. However, one of the most consistently misunderstood and perhaps most important methods for efficient water use and plant health is simply to water plants deeply . It is always, almost without exception, better to water somewhat less frequently and more deeply than to give your plants a small amount of water, say, every day. While there is no easy way to define 'deep watering' because plant species, site conditions, season, and water delivery method are all factors that affect the watering calculus, understanding the principle of deep versus shallow watering is essential. Watering (Photo from Pixabay.com)
In short, roots will grow where the water goes. Watering the top two to five inches of soil – even if done every day – causes the roots of plants to hover around that small halo of moisture. This can have devastating results as soon as a watering is missed or there is a particularly scorching day. The water in topsoil evaporates quickly, leaving plants without access to moisture. In our gardens, this is often remedied by a second emergency watering, leading to the use of more water for less payoff. On the other hand, if a plant has developed its root system to its maximum depth, it has access to water stored deeper in the soil that won't evaporate between waterings. There are other crucial benefits to the maximized root system, too: plants will have access to a broader supply of nutrients stored in the soil, and the diversity of root systems of different plants leads to less competition for both water and nutrients. This leads to resilient coexistence, not only between plant species but between us, our plants, our water bills, and our water ecologies.
When you're next watering, visualize the water soaking into the soil at a depth past the root mass of your plant; this will encourage the roots to grow deep and strong. It's okay if you don't know exactly how deep roots are, guessing is good enough! In the long term, you will save water by watering deeply and less frequently, and your plants will be significantly healthier and more resilient, to boot.

title: Live! At CSU Brings Concerts to Campus This Fall
author: Blaine Howerton
description:
Colorado State University is launching a new four-week, Friday night concert series this fall, with the first LIVE! at CSU show on Aug. 23. Through campus partnerships, the series also gives students a crash course in [...]
This post Live! At CSU Brings Concerts to Campus This Fall previously appeared on North Forty News.
content:
Colorado State University is launching a new four-week, Friday night concert series this fall, with the first LIVE! at CSU show on Aug. 23. Through campus partnerships, the series also gives students a crash course in live music management.
Shows are free and open to all, tickets are not required, and food trucks and beverages will be available.
The inaugural lineup will showcase local and regional talent, with high-energy shows that are authentically Fort Collins and uniquely CSU. Most artists hail from the region, including some Ram alumni and a few opening acts that feature current CSU students.
'CSU is thrilled to be part of Northern Colorado's thriving music scene,' said CSU President Amy Parsons. 'We are proud of all the programs and groups that bring quality live music to campus and to Northern Colorado – from the University Center for the Arts to the Music Business Program and the RamEvents student production group. LIVE! at CSU concerts are an exciting addition to the many opportunities that make our community one of the most vibrant college towns in the country.'
LIVE! at CSU is focused on bringing music to campus in a consistent manner moving forward, building on the existing foundation of the free, award-winning Lagoon Concert Series, and the sold-out Goose concert held on CSU's West Lawn in fall 2023.
The initial LIVE! series also adds activities to Ram athletics traditions, including the Ag Day and Rocky Mountain Showdown weekends, when Ram fans are invited to enjoy live music on Friday nights preceding game days at Canvas Stadium.
Student-led organizations, including the College of Business' Music Business Collective, RAMProductions, Ra mEvents and ASCSU, are joining forces with University Marketing and Communications to market and produce the shows. Their involvement ranges from the business side of music promotion and live show production to event management and day-of operations.
Mitch Killmer, senior business management major and member of the Music Business Collective, spent the summer supporting the Lagoon Concert Series alongside CSU staff, building his experience and understanding of what it takes to create seamless audience experiences.
'I'm really excited that CSU is showing its commitment to live music,' Killmer said. We're 'leveling up the size and talent of these shows, and I'm grateful to be able to work with the team and connect with industry pros throughout Colorado.'
Killmer and his fellow Collective members will support all four shows this fall, in his words, 'making everything seem natural – even if it's just carrying the trash bins out to the perfect spot – so the concertgoer doesn't have to worry about it.'
Corporate partnerships with Canvas Credit Union, New Belgium Brewery and Coca-Cola round out the community-driven series as the university balances local collaboration, sponsorship and student learning.
Concerts at CSU will continue beyond this fall. The university has opened its doors to the music industry to provide unique venue options in partnership with Northern Colorado's music scene, aiming to attract top talent to the region.

title: All About Oktoberfest with Fun Trivia at Horse & Dragon
description: Prost with a bier! All About Oktoberfest – a fun evening of socializing with an exciting trivia contest – will be held at 7:30 pm Sunday, Sept. 22, at Horse & Dragon Brewing Company. The [...]
content:
Prost with a bier!
All About Oktoberfest – a fun evening of socializing with an exciting trivia contest – will be held at 7:30 pm Sunday, Sept. 22, at Horse & Dragon Brewing Company. The Global Adventures club at the Global Village Museum of Arts and Cultures is hosting the festivities.
The 2024 Munich Oktoberfest, the largest folk festival in the world, will open at noon on Sept. 21 with the keg-tapping ceremony. According to long-standing tradition, the first beer barrel at Oktoberfest is always tapped at the Schottenhamel festival tent. After the successful tapping ceremony, 12 gunshots are fired to signal to the other festival tents that Oktoberfest has officially started and the beer can start flowing.
In Fort Collins, the Museum's Global Adventures club has organized All About Oktoberfest, featuring German beer, snacks, and music. The club's mission is to provide an interesting, interactive forum to learn and teach others about the many opportunities to discover, explore, and protect the world.
The trivia contest, with both prizes and surprises, will focus on the history of the Munich Oktoberfest, which is celebrating its 189 th year. Horse & Dragon Brewing Company is located at 124 Racquette Drive in Fort Collins.
Tickets for the evening are $40 per person and include refreshments and one beer, wine, or beverage. Reservations are required by Friday, Sept. 20, at globalvillagemuseum.org.
The Global Village Museum is located at 200 West Mountain Avenue, and Museum hours are 11 am to 5 pm Tuesday through Saturday. For more information and closure dates during the change of exhibits, visit globalvillagemuseum.org or call 970-221-4600.

title: Hosting the Ultimate Movie Night: Snacks, Themes, and More
author: Blaine Howerton
description: Grab some detailed tips for the ultimate movie night to host starting from- snacks, setup, and themes to games, post-movie discussion, and more.
content:
The ultimate movie night isn't always about just the movie!
You can amp up the mood of your event before the opening sequence and after the end credit rolls.
How?
Simple! Bring all the thrilling elements to your space!
The list includes– Delectable snacks
Themed decor
Perfect home theater setup
Right sound
Dim lights
Games and challenges
Intriguing music
Post-movie discussion
And many more!
The list is endless. But you can use them to turn an ordinary movie night into a blockbuster event! Reel-y! Looking for the easiest trick? Get Puffgogo! Its flavor and vibe will help make it more interesting! Key Takeaways: Ultimate Movie Night Planning Choose snacks that not only taste great but also enhance the movie experience.
Formulate creative themes to add an extra layer of thrill.
Set up a cozy and immersive movie setup that your guests will love. Choose The Perfect Snacks
Movie night doesn't feel complete without snacks. It's like a thriller without the thrill— complete vanilla.
So, impress your guests and make the cinema hours more exciting with the perfect snacks. [Image: Perfect movie night snacks] Classic Movie Snacks
Among varying options where you have DIYs, traditional, and contemporary dishes, some remain classic for movies. By classic, the only name that pops up is the popcorn. Popcorn
The name 'Popcorn' might come from its making process. However, it also gives a pop to the experience of watching movies that made it popular.
[Source: Statista, 2023] So, why is popcorn popular?
Simple– it's easy and quite reasonable to make. This makes it preferable not only in theater but also at home.
For movie night, you can try a variety of popcorn.
Here are different flavor and recipe options— if you wish to bring seasoned popcorn to your friends. Classic salted popcorn
Cheese popcorn
Corn with a vegan twist
Caramel-coated popcorn
Popcorn mixed in caramel
Butter-flavored popcorn
Jalapeno popcorn
Chocolate popcorn Candy and Chocolates
Something easy to grab and eat!
This is what anyone would want in snacks for a movie night. Hence, candies and chocolates are considered 'next classics'. They have a power that works to give you pleasure.
Both chocolates and candies are sweet. So they'll boost your and your guests' mood while watching a movie. Plus, they can make the entire experience better.
So, if you're hosting a movie night, consider multiple options— from popular choices to unique ideas.
Smokers can make it even more thrilling with flavored vaping. Disposables and mods tend to have some nicotine in different flavors of juice that boost the mood. You can find chocolate and candy options too.
So, offer pods or juices to your guests to keep them hooked on the movie.
Here are 5 options to consider: Themed Snacks
Some grubs work to fuel the excitement of watching certain movies.
You call them themed snacks. They can transform an ordinary movie night into a solid immersive experience.
So, match your snacks to the movie genre you and your friends will watch. This will surely impress them.
Here's a table for you to dig some themed snacks. You can mix and match too– based on your guests' palates and preferences!
If the list seems confusing, offer the common snacks that match any genre. Themed Snacks List Based On Genre [Image: Genre-wise themed snacks] DIY Snack Bar
This is one of the wisest ways to cut the mustard.
Set up a DIY snack bar. With this, you can cater to every guest's tastes. Such a bar lets them customize their snacks— which helps make your movie night more interactive.
You have to ensure the ingredients or snacks cover everyone's choice. Let's give you some ideas— Popcorn station
There should be different popcorn bases— Buttered.
Salted.
Sweet like caramel.
Cheese.
Have toppings like— Cheese flakes.
Cinnamon sugar.
Sprinkles
Pepper.
Chocolate chips.
The popularity of flavored popcorn is touching the sky. Consumers today are interested in different innovative flavors— familiar and unexpected— in the popcorn category. (Source: Mintel, 2018)
So, it's much safer to build a popcorn station with different flavoring options. Cheese Board With Other TitBits
Very few would say no to cheese!
Bring a variety of cheeses (cubes, flakes, and melted) to the table.
For movie night, think of–
However, only cheese won't suffice for longer movies. They also need a pair to complement and curb their cravings.
To create pairings, these options can be a hit:
Nacho Bar
This is a popular Mexican snack among people worldwide.
You can spice up the atmosphere of movie night with the right Nacho bar. Provide a spread of chips with different dippings.
Candy Buffet
Movie night shouldn't be all about savory.
Why not set out bowls of candies, nuts, and dried fruits? Keep the varieties in different bowls, separately.
Your guests will mix them up and create a sweet-sour-and-salty snack that matches their taste buds. Healthy Alternatives
Not all movie night snacks have to be indulgent.
Some guests, including you, can be vegan or health-conscious. Something healthy never means it'll be boring. Instead, multiple snacks have been introduced that can be healthy and mouth-watering.
Want some ideas? Vegan and Healthy Options
Create Engaging Movie Themes
Level up your game as a host for the ultimate movie night.
Give a thematic look to your home theater— one going with the movie genre you all picked. Keep it creative because this will keep your guests locked in.
You all might have already picked up a movie to watch tonight. Align your decor, snacks, and dress code with the genre.
This will take your guests to the world of the film. Genre-Based Themes
Need some ideas for decorating and setting the mood to match the movie genre? Check this out! Romantic Night
Romantic movies are for cuddle enthusiasts.
Set your home theater with— fragrant candles, dim lighting, rose petals, cute cushions, fairy lights, potpourri, and tents.
This kind of setup will draw the attention of love birds mostly. There will be an intimate atmosphere. And when the 'proposal in the rain' scene shows up, it'll make them go 'aww'. Action Night
This is the night to gear up for an adrenaline-pumping action movie.
Decorate the home theater with— airsoft guns, action figures, posters from iconic action films, hard cushions, camouflage gear, amber-toned LED striplights, and audible clocks.
The whole atmosphere will get everyone in the action-packed mood. Everyone will enjoy the intense vibe even more as the showdown between the protagonist and antagonist arrives. Thriller Night
'Cause this is a thriller, thriller night!
Create a 'sus-filled' atmosphere for this night. Include— dimming lights, shadowy decorations, masks, evidence board, airsoft guns, magnifying glasses, and notebooks for solving riddles.
Both– the atmosphere and the movie– will keep your guests on the edge of their seats to the end. Horror Night
Bring Halloween to your home theater for a horror movie night.
Give a spooky look to the room. Set it up with— flickering candles, lanterns, fake spider webs, skeletons, pumpkins, and ghoulish stuffed dolls.
Having this will create an eerie feeling. This can play a 'low-key' role in intensifying the jump scares for your friends. Comedy Night
Prepare for some giggles and ROFLs.
The setup of a comedy night movie should be light and fun with bright colors. Bring some— quirky decorations, an LED projector, Jim Carrey masks, posters with jokes written on them, and prop sticks with funny quotes.
This keeps your guests entertained and makes them enjoy the punchlines even more. Sci-Fi Night
You may have to think futuristic for a sci-fi movie night.
Think— silver and blue decor, space-themed props, glow-in-the-dark lights, a galactic LED projector, 3D glasses, and a VR headset.
Such decor will create a Sci-Fi mood at your home. The guests can explore the parallel dimensions of the movie more intensely. Costume Parties
Setting the dress code can take the movie night to another level.
Ask your friends if they can dress up as fictional characters for the night. The costumes will be based on the movie you guys will watch.
It's easier if the characters wear something we all do. For instance— characters in non-fiction movies wear regular attire. So, you need to check if you can recreate them.
Fiction and superhero movies usually have characters with unique costumes. Finding them can be tricky depending on how iconic it is.
If it's hard to grab costumes, opt for simple props.
Think of—
This is only to give you an idea. Check if it's easy or hard to recreate the costumes. Then settle on whether to go for it. Interactive Elements
Don't want your guests to get bored even for a second?
Then have some entertainment options! This will keep them hooked at your ultimate movie night event. Including interactive elements always makes any program a hit. The perks include— Higher energy.
Social linkup stimulation.
Effective interaction.
Stronger bonds.
Lit and memorable experiences
If you want all of them, try to have some creative activities and games. Here are some options— Guess the Movie
Meme Battle
Reverse Charades
Truth or Dare
UNO
Monopoly
Cloud-Chasing for Vapers
Cloud Tricks Competition for Vapers
Flavor Taste Test for Vapers Double Features and Marathons
Why stop at just one movie?
Movie lovers have the power to binge-watch multiple of them. If you all crave back-to-back films– host a double-feature or marathon.
This will turn the ultimate movie night into an epic event! Double Feature
Consider movies that go well with one another. It's great if there's a sequel, prequel, or remake.
For instance— 21 and 22 Jump Street (Sequels)
Extraction I and II (Sequels)
The Prestige and Oppenheimer (Christopher Nolan, thriller)
Shaun of the Dead and Zombieland (Zomedy genre)
What if there aren't any such options? In that case— pick two movies from the same genre, director, or actor. Series Marathon
It's going to be a very short night with this one.
Jokes aside. If a double-feature option isn't enough, a series marathon is perfect for all fans of movie series like—- Batman
Night At the Museum
Star Wars
Scream
Chronicles of Narnia
High School Musical
Terminator
So, why not host a marathon?
Wait! Don't forget to have plenty of snacks, beverages, and comfortable seating arrangements.
Because, you know, it can be a long night. Set Up the Ultimate Viewing Experience
Now bring all your focus on this part.
A setup can make or break the mood of watching a movie. Because you're hosting the event, you're responsible for making it lit. Home Theater Setup
The ultimate movie night means—- an immersive setup.
Your home theater system might be extra fancy. Or it's just a regular TV. It doesn't matter as long as you optimize the viewing experience. Television
It's okay if you have a regular TV for the movie night.
Yes. We won't suggest it for a big crowd. However, if it's 5 to 15 heads— even a TV work.
Just keep certain things in mind when setting it up for the homies–
Screen Size: Invite guests depending on the size of your TV. Because it's expensive to do it the other way!
Smaller screens (32-60 inches) can cover 6-8 guests whereas bigger screens (over 65 inches) can hold up to 15!
Resolution: It's better if the resolution is HD or 4k. That'll make sure the movie looks crisp and clear.
This is a must for detailed scenes and vibrant colors.
Viewing Distance: The seats should be comfortably far from the TV. A general rule is 1.5 to 2.5 times the screen size.
For instance— You have a 55-inch TV. So, your seating should be 8 to 13 feet away.
TV Placement: Position the TV at eye level. You must ensure your guests feel comfortable watching the movie and not get neck strain. Projector
Screen Size: In this case, you can buy a projector depending on your guests.
For 6 to 10 guests, a small project (80 to 100 inches) is enough. It's perfect for smaller spaces where the guests can sit close to the screen.
Opt for a larger projector screen (over 120 inches) if the guest count ranges from 12 to 20+. Such a projector is ideal for bigger spaces.
Resolution: Grab one that promises to have at least 1080p or 4K. This ensures a clear, detailed picture.
Projection Distance : Hook the projector to the wall, ceiling, or somewhere that provides the right projection.
Position it at the correct distance from the screen so your guests can enjoy watching it properly, clearly, and comfortably. Sound and Lighting
Proper sound and lighting level up the viewing experience.
So, grab the products that boast the best performance. Sound System
This plays a key role in enhancing the audio of a movie. So, buy one that has these factors—
Sound Quality: The system should deliver balanced sound, deep bass, balanced treble, and clear dialogue. Check for features like Dolby Atmos or DTS.
Connectivity: The sound system should have compatible ports. This includes— HDMI, Bluetooth, WiFi, or optical.
Config Vs. Room Size: Pick one that gives an immersive surround sound system. But first. Check– how big or small your home theater is.
Choose 7.1 for bigger rooms and 5.1 for smaller ones. Lighting
There's nothing much to do with the lighting.
Because movie night is all about entertainment in the darkest hours.
Don't want absolute darkness? Then dim the lights! It sets a mood for the movie and creates a theater-like ambiance.
You can also bring some candles, fairy lights, or an LED projector and use it depending on the movie everyone will watch. Comfortable Seating
A movie can be 2 to 3 hours long. The event can take a longer time to end.
Most of your guests will watch the movie while being seated. So, comfortable seating is a must!
Make sure the seating arrangements let every guest relax and enjoy the film. Consider options like—- Couches
Chairs
Floor Seating
Recliners
Bring a variety of options to seat. Also, have extra pillows, cushions, and blankets so your guests feel cozy. Outdoor Movie Night
Is the weather out there nice? Have a patio or backyard? Why not plan an outdoor movie night?
An outdoor screening offers an interesting and magical experience. It's quite different from indoor ones. Although the selection of foods, themes, and projectors will be similar, some arrangements will differ.
So, what do you need for an outdoor movie night? Projector with Bigger Screen
Speaker and 10.2 Sound System
Blank wall or Hanging white sheet
Inflatable loungers or basic outdoor chairs
Picnic blankets Add The Finishing Touches
Now everything's almost set. The only things left are— Invitations and RSVPs
Try to keep it creative! You can create invitation cards that go with the tone of your movie. It's suitable for a smaller guest list and they'll love the effort!
Think— Love-shaped cards with love quotes for a romantic movie.
Weird-shaped cards with dad jokes for comedy movies.
Cards with iconic action elements for action movies.
3D cards for Sci-fi movies.
You can keep it modern with e-cards or e-vites. This is easier if you have a bigger guest list.
There are multiple creative ways to make e-vites for movie nights interesting. You can share memes and gifs. Use graphic elements to make the card look dope!
Don't forget to include all the details. Make it easy for them to RSVP so you know how many guests to expect.
For RSVP— you can use an online platform or tell them to text you. Pre-Movie Entertainment
Movie night doesn't have to be just about the movie watching.
Add something fun to keep your guests hooked even before it starts. Have some— Fun activities like dumb charades or meme battles.
Playlist for music. Try to include the ones that match the movie genre.
Photo booth
Vape games and challenges
Starters and light snacks
Dessert corners Post-Movie Discussion
The fun doesn't have to end when the credits roll.
Ask your friends and guests to stick around for a post-movie discussion. This can be a good chance to share and exchange thoughts and experiences about the movie. It's like giving feedback. You can have notes with a pros and cons list . Hand it to your guests and let them share the positive and negative points regarding the film.
There can be discussion questions too! Prepare a few open-ended questions on the movie. Frequently Asked Questions
Popcorn, chips, and assorted candies are the best snacks for a movie night.
Choose a movie theme depending on genre, mood, or favorite films to match your guests' tastes.
Get a projector, big screen, immersive 10.2 sound system, and comfortable seating for an outdoor movie night.
Add creative options like— games, challenges, fun activities, themed costumes, and post-movie discussion. This will make your movie night interactive. Host A Blockbuster Movie Night!
It's all about paying attention to the details. Just make sure to select the right snacks, design a genre-based theme, set up a comfy viewing environment, and add some fun elements. All of these will contribute to the overall experience.

title: Why Business Registration is the First Step to Building Your Brand
description: Starting a business is an exciting journey filled with opportunities to bring your vision to life. However, one of the most crucial steps in this journey is often overlooked or underestimated:…
content:
A business owner is using his smartphone https://www.pexels.com/photo/serious-businessman-using-smartphone-on-street-3932353/
Starting a business is an exciting journey filled with opportunities to bring your vision to life. However, one of the most crucial steps in this journey is often overlooked or underestimated: business registration. This legal process is not just a formality; it lays the foundation for your brand, protects your interests, and paves the way for long-term success. In this blog, we'll explore why business registration is the first step to building your brand and how it sets the stage for your future growth. Understanding Business Registration What is Business Registration?
Business registration is the process of legally registering your company with the appropriate government authorities. This step is essential for establishing your business as a separate legal entity, whether it's a sole proprietorship, partnership, limited liability company (LLC), or corporation. Registration involves choosing a business name, selecting a legal structure, and obtaining any necessary licenses or permits. Legal Protection and Liability
One of the primary reasons for NH business registration is to gain legal protection. By registering, you create a distinct legal entity separate from yourself as an individual. This separation means that your personal assets are protected from any liabilities or debts incurred by the business. In other words, if your business faces legal issues or financial difficulties, your personal savings, property, and other assets are shielded from claims. Establishing Brand Identity Legitimacy and Credibility
Registering your business gives it a level of legitimacy and credibility that is crucial for building a brand. Customers, suppliers, and partners are more likely to trust and engage with a registered business because it demonstrates a commitment to operating legally and ethically. This credibility can set you apart from competitors who may not have taken this step, making it easier to build relationships and attract clients. Securing Your Business Name
When you register your business, you secure the exclusive right to use your chosen business name within your jurisdiction. This is vital for brand identity, as your business name is often the first impression customers have of your brand. Securing your name prevents others from using it, reducing the risk of confusion in the marketplace and helping you establish a unique and recognizable brand. Trademark Protection
In addition to registering your business name, you might also consider trademarking your brand name, logo, or slogan. Trademark protection adds another layer of security, ensuring that your brand's identity is protected on a national or even global scale. This can be particularly important as your business grows and expands into new markets. Facilitating Growth and Expansion Access to Funding
Business registration is often a prerequisite for accessing funding opportunities. Whether you're seeking a bank loan, venture capital, or government grants, registered businesses are typically considered more reliable and stable. Investors and lenders are more likely to provide financial support to a registered business because it indicates a serious, long-term commitment to the venture. Building Creditworthiness
Once registered, your business can begin to build its credit history, separate from your personal credit. This is important for securing loans and credit lines at favorable terms in the future. A strong business credit profile can also make it easier to negotiate with suppliers and reduce your operational costs. Expanding into New Markets
As your business grows, you may want to expand into new markets, whether domestically or internationally. A registered business has the legal standing needed to enter contracts, establish partnerships, and operate in different regions. Without proper registration, expanding your business could be legally complex or even impossible. Compliance and Legal Obligations Meeting Regulatory Requirements
Every business must comply with a range of legal and regulatory requirements, from tax filings to labor laws. Business registration ensures that you are on the right side of the law, reducing the risk of fines, penalties, or even the shutdown of your business. Compliance with legal obligations also protects your brand's reputation, as customers are more likely to trust businesses that operate transparently and ethically. Avoiding Legal Disputes
Operating a business without proper registration can lead to various legal disputes, such as disagreements over business ownership or issues with intellectual property. By registering your business, you create a clear legal framework that can help prevent or resolve these disputes more effectively. Simplifying Taxation
Registered businesses often benefit from simplified tax processes , including the ability to deduct business expenses, access tax credits, and file taxes separately from personal income. Proper registration also ensures that you meet all tax obligations, avoiding the potential legal troubles that come with tax evasion or non-compliance. Building Customer Trust Enhancing Brand Reputation
In today's market, consumers are more informed and cautious about the companies they choose to support. A registered business is seen as more professional and trustworthy, which can significantly enhance your brand's reputation. This trust is critical for building a loyal customer base, as people are more likely to engage with a brand they perceive as legitimate and reliable. Gaining Competitive Advantage
In a crowded marketplace, any advantage can make a difference. By registering your business, you demonstrate to customers that you are serious about your venture. This can give you a competitive edge, particularly in industries where trust and professionalism are key factors in consumer decision-making. Building Long-Term Relationships
Customer trust is the foundation of long-term business relationships. By establishing your brand as a registered entity, you lay the groundwork for building lasting connections with your customers. This trust can lead to repeat business, positive word-of-mouth referrals, and a stronger overall brand presence in the market. Conclusion
Business registration is more than just a legal requirement; it is the first and most critical step in building your brand. From establishing credibility and securing your business name to facilitating growth and ensuring compliance, registration provides the foundation upon which your business can thrive. By taking this step, you not only protect your interests but also set the stage for long-term success, allowing your brand to grow and evolve with confidence. Whether you're just starting out or looking to expand, registering your business is an investment in your brand's future.

title: Why CBD Gummies Are a Natural Choice for Anxiety Management
description: Anxiety is a common issue that affects millions of people worldwide. While traditional treatments like therapy and medication are often effective, many individuals are turning to natural alternatives…
content:
Photo by lord_ photon from Pexels
Anxiety is a common issue that affects millions of people worldwide. While traditional treatments like therapy and medication are often effective, many individuals are turning to natural alternatives to manage their symptoms. One such alternative that has gained popularity is CBD (cannabidiol) gummies. These tasty, convenient treats offer a natural way to alleviate anxiety without the side effects associated with pharmaceutical drugs. In this blog, we will explore why CBD gummies are becoming a preferred choice for anxiety management and how they can benefit those seeking a natural remedy. Understanding CBD and Its Effects on Anxiety What is CBD?
CBD, or cannabidiol, is a compound derived from the hemp plant. Unlike THC (tetrahydrocannabinol), another compound found in cannabis, CBD does not produce a psychoactive 'high.' Instead, it interacts with the body's endocannabinoid system, which regulates various physiological processes, including mood, sleep, and pain. How CBD Helps with Anxiety
CBD has been shown to have a calming effect on the central nervous system. It interacts with receptors in the brain that influence the release of neurotransmitters like serotonin, often called the 'feel-good' hormone. By promoting a balanced serotonin level, CBD can help reduce feelings of anxiety, stress, and tension. Additionally, CBD's anti-inflammatory properties may help alleviate physical symptoms of anxiety, such as headaches and muscle tension. For those seeking relief, exploring the best gummies for anxiety can be an effective and convenient way to incorporate CBD into your wellness routine. The Benefits of Using CBD Gummies for Anxiety Easy and Convenient Dosing
One of the main reasons people choose CBD gummies for anxiety management is the ease of dosing. Each gummy contains a pre-measured amount of CBD, making it simple to control your intake. This consistency is particularly important for those new to CBD, as it allows for a gradual increase in dosage until the desired effect is achieved. Unlike other forms of CBD, such as oils or tinctures, there's no need to measure out doses, which can be both messy and inconvenient. Discreet and Portable
CBD gummies are also incredibly discreet and portable, making them ideal for daily use. Whether at work, traveling, or out in public, you can easily take a gummy without drawing attention. This convenience allows for on-the-go anxiety management, providing relief whenever and wherever it's needed. The familiar gummy format also makes them more approachable for those hesitant to try other forms of CBD. Long-Lasting Effects
Another advantage of CBD gummies is their long-lasting effects. When ingested, CBD is slowly released into the bloodstream as the gummies are digested. This gradual release can provide sustained anxiety relief throughout the day, making it easier to manage symptoms without needing to re-dose frequently. For many, this extended relief is a key benefit, especially when compared to other anxiety management methods that may require more frequent attention. A Tasty and Enjoyable Experience
Let's face it—many people find the taste of CBD oil to be unpleasant. CBD gummies, on the other hand, come in a variety of flavors, making them a delicious and enjoyable way to take CBD. The pleasant taste of gummies can make the process of managing anxiety more enjoyable, turning it into a positive part of your daily routine rather than a chore. Why Choose CBD Gummies Over Other Forms of CBD? Better Tolerated by the Digestive System
For individuals with sensitive stomachs, CBD gummies may be a better choice than other forms of CBD. Since the gummies are broken down slowly in the digestive system, they are less likely to cause stomach discomfort than oils or capsules. This slow digestion also means the CBD is released over time, leading to a more gradual and sustained effect. No Measuring or Mixing Required
CBD oils and tinctures require careful measuring, which can be inconvenient and messy. Gummies eliminate this hassle by providing a consistent dose in each piece. There's no need to worry about spilling oil, getting the dose wrong, or mixing it into food or drinks. The convenience of pre-measured doses makes CBD gummies a user-friendly option, especially for beginners. A Gentle Introduction to CBD
For those new to CBD, starting with gummies can be less intimidating than jumping straight into oils or vaping. Gummies are familiar and easy to consume, making them a gentle introduction to the world of CBD. The mild effects of CBD gummies also allow beginners to ease into their anxiety management routine without the worry of overwhelming sensations. What to Look for When Choosing CBD Gummies Quality and Purity
When selecting CBD gummies for anxiety management, it's important to choose high-quality products free from contaminants. Look for gummies made with organic, non-GMO hemp and free from artificial additives. Reputable brands will also provide third-party lab testing results to confirm the purity and potency of their products. Appropriate Dosage
CBD gummies come in various strengths, so choosing a product that aligns with your needs is essential. Beginners may want to start with a lower dosage (e.g., 5-10 mg per gummy) and gradually increase as needed. It's always advisable to consult with a healthcare provider before starting any new supplement, especially if you are currently taking medication or have underlying health conditions. Full-Spectrum vs. Isolate
CBD gummies can be made with full-spectrum, broad-spectrum, or CBD isolate. Full-spectrum products contain all the cannabinoids, terpenes, and other beneficial compounds found in the hemp plant, including trace amounts of THC. Broad-spectrum products include all these compounds except THC, while CBD isolate contains only pure CBD. Depending on your preferences and any concerns about THC, you can choose the type that best suits your needs. Conclusion
CBD gummies offer a natural, convenient, and enjoyable way to manage anxiety. With their easy dosing, discreet nature, and long-lasting effects, they have become a popular choice for those seeking an alternative to traditional anxiety treatments. As with any supplement, it's important to choose high-quality products from reputable brands and consult a healthcare provider to determine the best dosage for your needs. Whether you're new to CBD or looking for a more enjoyable way to manage anxiety, CBD gummies could be the perfect solution

title: Illegal Gambling in the US Continues to Rise
description: It's been another successful year for the American gambling industry. A Yield Sec report has shown that gross gaming revenue (GGR) for the first six months of this year was $39.9 billion, according…
content:
https://pixabay.com/photos/gambling-contest-poker-happiness-4178462/
It's been another successful year for the American gambling industry. A Yield Sec report has shown that gross gaming revenue (GGR) for the first six months of this year was $39.9 billion, according to agamble.com . However, of this amount, $29.1 billion came from unlicensed and unregulated illegal betting platforms.
The Yield Sec report stated that the GGR for legal betting sites was $10.8 billion between January and the end of June 2024. They use predictive analytics when compiling their statistics. Their report highlights the problem of illegal gambling sites that exist in the US.
In 2018 a US Supreme Court Judge ruling changed the American gambling industry. He ruled in favor of campaigners who wanted individual states to be able to make the final decision on whether or not to make sports betting legal.
This has led to over 30 US states going down the legalization route but despite this, many gamblers still prefer to use unlicensed sites to place their wagers.
The report states that the number of illegal operators in the US for the first six months of 2024 was 892. There were also 651 affiliates who have been promoting these illegal platforms.
Last year saw Yield Sec make a prediction that GGR for the US gambling industry would be $40.9 billion in 2024. The figures they have released for the first six months indicate that will easily be surpassed.
This year has already seen Vermont and North Carolina join those who have made gambling legal in their states. North Carolina has long been a popular state for gambling at casinos but now online sports betting is legal.
In terms of population, North Carolina is the ninth biggest state in the US. It is sixth in terms of population on the legal betting state list. The first five months of business have seen $340 million taken in bets. This has produced reported revenue of $42 million.
The Super Bowl is a betting bonanza every year. Even those who don't regularly bet on sport want to have a flutter on what is one of the largest sporting events in the world. However, Yield Sec reported that two-thirds of bets placed in the US this year on the Super Bowl were made on illegal platforms.
Speaking about their findings, Ismail Vail (the CEO of Yield Sec) said that 'legal operators are under serious pressure.' The CEO added that the focus should be on that $29.1 billion figure. It's a huge amount that has been lost to the illegal side of the US gambling industry.
That's not just an amount that is hitting the revenues of legal US gambling companies. One of the key reasons US states are in favor of making gambling legal is the tax that they can receive from the industry. They are missing out therefore on the tax that could be received from that $29.1 billion.
It also puts gamblers in danger because of the lack of customer protection that exists in the illegal betting market. This puts gamblers at risk of unfair practices with there being no regulation of the unlicensed sites.
If a gambler is unhappy about the licensed site they are a member of, then they can make a complaint to the regulatory body in their state. They will then investigate the complaint and take action if they feel it is necessary. That simply isn't the case with the unlicensed gambling sites in the US.
The problems caused by the illegal betting market are nothing new unfortunately. Back in 2022, Yield Sec reported that the GGR for the illegal market totalled $42 billion. There was a slight fall to $40.9 billion last year but the problem seems to be growing this year. The total for the first half of this year is already over half of that recorded for 2023.
It's estimated that the final figure for this year could be $60 billion. That's possible as the second half of this year will see the return of the NFL, College football and NBA and that will provide plenty of potential betting revenue. The final four months of the year usually accounts for 35% of the yearly US operator handle.
The legal betting market is progressing well. The forecast by Yield Sec is that the total GGR for this year will be at least $20 billion. That would be over $3 billion more than last year and considerably higher than the 2022 figure of $12.3 billion. They are impressive figures but the industry knows they could be even higher if action was taken against the illegal betting market.

title: Tips to Avoid Skiing Crowds in Denver
description: Denver, nestled in the heart of the Rockies, is a premier destination for skiing enthusiasts. With world-class resorts just a short drive from the city, it's no wonder that skiers flock to the area…
content:
Photo by Visit Almaty: https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-doing-ice-skiing-on-snow-field-in-shallow-focus-photography-848618/
Denver, nestled in the heart of the Rockies, is a premier destination for skiing enthusiasts. With world-class resorts just a short drive from the city, it's no wonder that skiers flock to the area during the winter season. However, navigating the crowds can be a challenge, especially on busy weekends and holidays. If you're looking to enjoy the slopes without the hustle and bustle, here are some tips to help you avoid skiing crowds in Denver. 1. Choose Off-Peak Times
One of the simplest ways to avoid crowds is to plan your skiing trips during off-peak times: Weekdays vs. Weekends: Skiing on weekdays, particularly Tuesday through Thursday, often means fewer crowds compared to weekends. Resorts are generally less busy, and lift lines are shorter.
Early Mornings or Late Afternoons: Arriving at the ski resort early in the morning or later in the afternoon can help you avoid peak times. Early birds often enjoy fresh tracks, while late skiers can take advantage of reduced crowds and potentially better deals.
Timing your ski trips strategically can make a significant difference in your experience on the slopes. 2. Visit Lesser-Known Resorts
While popular resorts like Vail and Aspen are renowned for their amenities, they also attract larger crowds. Consider exploring some of the lesser-known resorts near Denver: Loveland Ski Area: Located just 53 miles from Denver, Loveland offers a more relaxed atmosphere and less crowded slopes. It's known for its excellent snow conditions and variety of terrain.
Berthoud Falls: This smaller resort offers a more intimate skiing experience, with fewer crowds and beautiful mountain scenery.
Eldora Mountain Resort : Situated about 21 miles from Boulder, Eldora provides a great alternative to the larger resorts, with a laid-back vibe and diverse trails.
Exploring these alternative resorts can lead to a more enjoyable and peaceful skiing experience. 3. Plan Your Trip for the Off-Season
The holiday season and school vacation periods are peak times for skiing, leading to larger crowds. To avoid this: Ski Early or Late in the Season: The start of the ski season in November or the end of the season in April can be less crowded than the mid-winter peak. Snow conditions are often still excellent, and you can enjoy a quieter experience.
Avoid Major Holidays: If possible, plan your ski trips outside major holidays like Christmas, New Year's, and President's Day. Resorts are particularly busy during these times.
Opting for off-season skiing can provide a more relaxed and enjoyable experience on the slopes. 4. Utilize Less Popular Trails
Even at popular resorts, some trails are less frequented than others: Explore the Resort's Map: Check the resort's trail map and seek out less popular areas. Some trails are less traveled and can provide a quieter skiing experience.
Ask the Locals: Resort staff and local skiers can offer insights into which trails are less crowded. They often have valuable tips for finding hidden gems on the mountain.
Taking the time to explore less popular trails can enhance your skiing experience by avoiding crowded areas. 5. Consider Alternative Ski Activities
If skiing itself becomes too crowded, consider alternative activities that are also enjoyable: Snowshoeing: Many resorts offer snowshoeing trails, which can provide a peaceful and scenic alternative to skiing.
Cross-Country Skiing : Cross-country skiing is another excellent way to enjoy the snow while avoiding the crowds found on downhill slopes.
Exploring these alternative activities can provide a refreshing change and allow you to enjoy the winter landscape without the crowds. 6. Stay in Nearby Towns
Instead of staying in the most popular resort towns, consider lodging in smaller nearby towns: Frisco: Located near Breckenridge, Frisco offers a charming atmosphere and easy access to several ski resorts without the high volume of tourists.
Silverthorne: Situated close to Keystone and Breckenridge, Silverthorne provides a quieter base with convenient access to multiple resorts.
Georgetown: A historic town with a quaint feel, Georgetown is about an hour from Denver and offers a peaceful retreat from the bustling resort areas.
Staying in these quieter towns can help you avoid the crowds while still being close to excellent skiing opportunities. 7. Utilize Ski Passes Wisely
Season passes and multi-resort passes can offer flexibility and help you avoid crowds: Off-Peak Days: Use your ski pass on days that are historically less crowded. Check the pass's blackout dates and plan your skiing trips accordingly.
Midweek Discounts: Some resorts offer discounts or special deals for pass holders on less busy days, making midweek skiing even more appealing.
By planning your skiing days around your pass benefits, you can enjoy quieter slopes and better deals. 8. Check Crowd Levels Before You Go
Many ski resorts provide real-time updates on crowd levels and lift wait times: Resort Websites and Apps: Check the resort's website or mobile app for live updates on crowd levels and lift lines. Some resorts even offer real-time webcams to monitor conditions.
Social Media: Follow the resorts on social media for updates and insights from other skiers about current conditions and crowd levels.
Staying informed can help you make better decisions about when and where to ski, avoiding crowded times. 9. Prepare for Winter Weather
Winter weather can affect crowd levels and skiing conditions: Check Weather Forecasts: Severe weather conditions can impact resort crowds and skiing conditions. Check weather forecasts and plan your trips around favorable conditions.
Be Prepared for Changing Conditions: Winter weather can be unpredictable. Ensure you're prepared for varying conditions by dressing in layers and carrying essential gear.
Being prepared for the weather can help you adapt to changing conditions and avoid unexpected crowds. 10. Hire a Denver Car Accident Lawyer if Needed
While navigating the snowy roads to your ski destination, it's important to be cautious. Car accidents can happen, especially in winter conditions. If you find yourself involved in a car accident while traveling to or from a ski resort, hiring a trustworthy Denver car accident lawyer can be crucial: Legal Expertise: A Denver car accident lawyer can provide legal guidance and help you navigate the complexities of insurance claims and legal proceedings.
Claim Assistance: They can assist in gathering evidence, negotiating with insurance companies, and representing your interests to ensure fair compensation for any damages or injuries.
Peace of Mind: Having a lawyer handle the legal aspects can alleviate stress and allow you to focus on recovering and getting back to enjoying your skiing adventures.
Ensuring you have the right legal support can make a significant difference if you encounter any unexpected issues on your journey. Conclusion
Avoiding skiing crowds in Denver requires a combination of strategic planning, flexibility, and a willingness to explore alternative options. By choosing off-peak times, visiting lesser-known resorts, and utilizing smart travel and skiing strategies, you can enjoy a more relaxed and enjoyable skiing experience. Additionally, being prepared for unexpected events, such as car accidents, and knowing how to handle them with the help of a Denver car accident lawyer, can further enhance your winter adventure. With these tips in mind, you can make the most of your skiing trips and enjoy the stunning winter landscapes of Denver without the stress of overcrowded slopes.

title: Larimer County Offers First Public Tours of New Canyon Edge Open Space
description: As part of National Public Lands Day week (Sept. 24-28), the Larimer County Department of Natural Resources (LCDNR) is launching public tours of its newest open space at the former Heaven's Door…
content:
Steep hogbacks overlook a green valley at the Canyon Edge Open Space. (Photo courtesy Larimer County Department of Natural Resources)
As part of National Public Lands Day week (Sept. 24-28), the Larimer County Department of Natural Resources (LCDNR) is launching public tours of its newest open space at the former Heaven's Door Ranch. LCDNR is pleased to announce that the open space will be called Canyon Edge Open Space following the recent completion of a public naming process.
Canyon Edge Open Space was acquired by Larimer County in 2022 and is located at the edge of the Big Thompson Canyon. It provides a critical landscape connection between other conserved lands within Larimer County's high-priority Blue Mountain Conservation Area. The Canyon Edge Open Space provides winter range for elk traveling down from the mountains. (Photo by Dawn Wilson)
The first public tour is Thursday, Sept. 26, and is open to any community member who would like to see the land up close and learn more about this unique open space. Registration is free, but space is limited to 20 people per tour. To ensure more people can participate, attendees are asked to join only one tour.
Tour participants will get an in-depth look at this 1,547-acre property that once served as a private ranch. A 1.5 hour walk along an existing road will include discussion of the property's natural resource features and values, and the steps LCDNR is taking to restore the land.
Currently, LCDNR is in the process of removing remnant fencing and restoring native plant communities. Moving forward, LCDNR will look towards developing a management plan and in the longer-term nature-based public use and associated facilities, such as parking, restrooms, picnic sites and trails.
Registration for public tours is now live. Members of the public can register for a date on LCDNR's public calendar: https://offero.larimer.org/calendar
Canyon Edge Open Space Public Tour Schedule 2024:
Thursday, Sept. 26: 5:30-7 p.m.
Saturday, Oct. 12: 10-11:30 a.m.
Saturday, Nov. 9: 10-11:30 a.m.
Those who cannot attend this fall's tours will have more opportunities in 2025 and beyond.
Find more information about Canyon Edge Open Space through this link: https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/parks/canyon-edge
Canyon Edge Open Space Background: In 2022, LCDNR purchased the Canyon Edge Open Space, formerly known as Heaven's Door Ranch. With the help of the cities of Fort Collins and Loveland and a retroactive $1.5 million grant from Great Outdoors Colorado (GOCO), the county was able to purchase the property for $9 million.

title: How to Choose the Right Nursing Home
description: The decision to send an aging parent or relative to a nursing home takes work. It can come with many complex emotions, including relief that they will receive the necessary care, guilt that you cannot…
content:
The decision to send an aging parent or relative to a nursing home takes work. It can come with many complex emotions, including relief that they will receive the necessary care, guilt that you cannot personally provide that care, and financial strain thinking about how to afford the often expensive quality care facilities. Ultimately, nursing homes can offer older adults the support and medical attention they need to feel more comfortable. But how can you and your family know which nursing home is best? Distance and Proximity
A state-of-the-art nursing home may seem ideal for an elderly family member. After all, you want them to feel pampered and comfortable. However, more than choosing the fanciest facility, you should consider whether it will be convenient for friends and family to visit. A reputable nursing home around the block is a much better choice than the most elite facility in the greater area, especially if it means you can see your loved one more often.
Research suggests that frequent visitations to your aging relative in a nursing home can positively impact their physical and mental well-being . Additionally, visiting them often allows you to stay updated on their condition, monitor their well-being, and ensure that the quality of care is up to standard. If nursing home staff see that you are checking up on them frequently, they are more likely to be extra diligent in their care. Cost
Cost is an essential factor when choosing a nursing home. Medicare often covers short-stay nursing home residencies, but long-stay costs will most likely only be covered with private insurance or at the out-of-pocket expense of the senior or their family. Since nursing homes generally include 24/7 care, they tend to be expensive.
Many factors influence the cost of long-term nursing home care. Location, the quality of the facility, room type, and the type of care most influence the price difference. Depending on financial need, Medicaid options may be available for families needing financial assistance—but most families find their elderly parent or relative does not meet the threshold. Medicare Ratings
The 5-Star-Quality Rating System, facilitated by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), offers comprehensive ratings for nursing home care facilities. The ratings are based on health inspection scores, care quality, and staffing ratios. When attempting to assess a nursing home's care standards, start by reviewing CMS ratings.
While online ratings should always be taken with a grain of salt, pay special attention to important information that could indicate that the facility is poorly run or understaffed. This includes citations, cases of bed sores, cases of sepsis , or other forms of elder neglect or abuse.
While individuals working in nursing homes may not be purposefully neglectful or abusive, burn-out, improper training, or poor care plans can lead staff to engage in inappropriate behaviors. Instances of elder abuse in nursing homes are not as rare as one might think, with about 16% of aging adults experiencing abuse in institutional settings. Be sure to do your due diligence. Research & Reputation
On top of checking Medicare ratings, consider reaching out to friends and family who may have recent experience with a local nursing home. First-hand experience and references can be beneficial when deciding if a particular location will be a good fit for an elderly parent or relative. Local agencies or newspapers may also have the scoop on well-rated or reputable nursing homes in the area .
Google users may also have provided reviews about a particular facility—just remember that many individuals only leave reviews when they've had a bad experience. At the same time, now that establishments have realized the importance of public reviews, they may encourage patients or their families to leave inflated reviews. Pay attention to the specifics of a review. Get a Feel for the Place
Before settling on a particular facility, arrange to check it out in person. Do not feel shy about interviewing staff members, administrators, or those with first-hand experience working with patients daily. Ask them how they handle visitations, medications, emergencies, and other specifics that may affect the older adults in their care.
Consider going during off-peak hours to get a feel of how residents and staff interact without the vigilant eye of visitors. Observe the general mood, condition, and sociability of the residents currently staying in the facility. Can you picture your loved one feeling comfortable and cared for in that place? Conclusion
Despite the challenges of caregiving for an elderly parent or relative, there are resources to support you and your family. A nursing home can be one of those resources—round-the-clock nursing and medical staff can provide much-needed assistance to aging adults and the infrastructure for social engagement. Yet, not all nursing homes boast the same level of care, and in some unfortunate cases, they may even facilitate abusive or neglectful behavior. Be sure to consider which facility best fits you and your family thoroughly.
