title: The Vibrant Afterlife of Christmas Trees
description: Indigo Deany | Fort Collins Nursery When the holidays roll around, we can all expect to witness the classic debate between those who swear by artificial Christmas trees and those who pledge themselves…
content:
Indigo Deany | Fort Collins Nursery
When the holidays roll around, we can all expect to witness the classic debate between those who swear by artificial Christmas trees and those who pledge themselves to real ones. While there are pros and cons to each option, organizations such as the Nature Conservancy recommend buying real trees for myriad reasons: you are supporting local tree farmers, the carbon footprint of producing them is net positive, some tree harvesting operations support wildfire management programs, and, perhaps most pressingly, real trees are recyclable and biodegradable. Whether you are a stalwart real tree advocate or are just trying to learn more about them, it is helpful to know what your local options are for recycling the tree once January (February, March, anyone?) comes around.
In the Fort Collins area, the city and county operate several locations where you can drop off your real tree for a small fee. All you need to do is remove any artificial components you may have added for decoration, including ornament hooks, wire, fake snow, and lights. Real trees of any size are accepted. The city uses these trees to create mulch. Drop-off locations are:
—Ewing Landscape Materials: 3501 E. Prospect Avenue, 80525 ($5/tree)
—City of Fort Collins Timberline Recycling Center: 1903 S. Timberline Road, 80525 ($5 entry fee, $5/tree)
—Larimer County Green Waste Program: 5887 S. Taft Hill Road, 80521 ($5/tree, from December 26-January 16)
Did you know goats absolutely love mowing down Yule trees? From the needles to the pinecones, conifers are one of their favorite treats, and this time of year is as much a culinary treat for them as it is for us. Consider reaching out to one of our local goat farms to see if they are willing to take your old tree. A few local options are Mountain View Dairy Goats (Fort Collins) and Cabri Creamery (Wellington).
If you're a bird enthusiast and want to offer additional winter shelter for those flighty friends, take your old tree outside. Simply secure it to something upright in a spot relatively sheltered from the wind, and you have created a refuge for the birds. In the springtime, take the brittle tree down and repurpose it for various garden supports. Long branches can be used to make trellises for your climbing beans, cucumbers, and more! The thicker trunk can be sliced into discs for coasters, shims, or other creative projects. Whatever you decide to do with your post-holiday, real Christmas tree, you can sleep easy at night knowing that its afterlife is meaningful, regenerative, and vibrant.

title: 6 Easy Ways to Turn Your Kitchen Into a Modern Masterpiece
description: Your kitchen is more than a place to cook – it's the heart of your home. Turning it into a modern masterpiece doesn't have to mean a complete overhaul. With a few simple updates, you [...]
content:
Image source: https://unsplash.com/photos/brown-wooden-shelf-CX8ooha2yLA
Your kitchen is more than a place to cook – it's the heart of your home. Turning it into a modern masterpiece doesn't have to mean a complete overhaul. With a few simple updates, you can transform your kitchen into a sleek, functional, and visually stunning space. Here are six easy ways to achieve that modern look you've been dreaming of. Upgrade Kitchen Taps
Swap out old, standard faucets for sleek, contemporary designs like pull-down or touchless models. Matte black, brushed gold, or stainless steel finishes are popular choices that add sophistication to your sink area. Modern taps also come with functional upgrades, such as built-in filtration systems or adjustable spray settings, making them both stylish and practical. You can also explore premium tapware to add a touch of luxury and sophistication to your kitchen's modern design. This simple change can instantly elevate the overall aesthetic of your kitchen. Upgrade to Sleek, Minimalist Cabinets
Modern kitchens thrive on clean lines and simplicity. Replace outdated cabinetry with flat-panel or handleless designs in neutral colors like white, gray, or black. High-gloss finishes add a reflective quality that makes your space feel larger and more contemporary. If a full replacement isn't in your budget, consider repainting or refacing your cabinets for a fresh look. Opt for Soft-Close Mechanisms
Soft-close hinges and drawers are a must-have feature in modern kitchens. Not only do they add a luxurious, high-end feel, but they also prevent slamming, which prolongs the lifespan of your cabinets. The quiet, smooth closing action is a subtle yet impactful upgrade that enhances the overall functionality of your kitchen. Consider Custom Cabinetry
While premade cabinets can work well, custom cabinetry offers the ultimate flexibility. You can design your cabinets to fit your exact needs, whether that's more drawer space for utensils or larger cabinets for pots and pans. Custom cabinetry allows you to create a cohesive, tailored look that matches your vision for the space. Choose Light Wood Finishes
Light wood tones like oak or birch are perfect for a modern, airy vibe. They create a natural warmth while maintaining a sleek appearance. Pairing these finishes with white or black accents can further emphasize the minimalist design and keep the overall aesthetic fresh and contemporary. Install Statement Lighting Fixtures
Lighting plays a huge role in creating a modern aesthetic. Swap out traditional fixtures for bold, geometric pendants or industrial-style chandeliers. Position them strategically over your island or dining area to make them a focal point. Choose LED lighting for an energy-efficient option that doesn't compromise on brightness or style. Opt for a Minimalist Color Palette
The modern design emphasizes a cohesive and understated color scheme. Stick to two or three primary tones, like white, gray, and wood accents. This creates a sleek and harmonious look. Incorporate pops of color through accessories like bar stools, rugs, or wall art for added personality without overwhelming the space. Neutral Tones for a Timeless Look
Neutral colors such as white, gray, and beige are staples in modern kitchens because they provide a clean, timeless backdrop. These shades can be paired with various textures, from matte finishes to shiny surfaces, to create depth and interest. They also offer versatility, allowing you to change the look of your kitchen with new accessories or decor without needing to repaint or replace larger elements. Add Warmth with Wood Accents
Introducing natural wood tones in a modern kitchen adds warmth and texture to an otherwise minimalist space. Consider incorporating wood elements in your cabinets, countertops, or open shelving. This contrast against neutral colors creates a balanced, inviting atmosphere that still maintains a sleek, contemporary look. Use Contrasting Dark and Light Shades
A modern kitchen often includes a balance of light and dark shades to add depth and sophistication. Pairing white or light gray walls with dark countertops, or black cabinets with a lighter backsplash, can create a striking contrast. This approach prevents the space from feeling too sterile, keeping it visually interesting while maintaining a minimalist aesthetic. Focus on Countertops and Backsplashes
Nothing says modern like streamlined countertops and a striking backsplash. Choose materials like quartz or polished concrete for their durability and sleek appearance. Pair them with a backsplash made of glass, subway tiles, or metallic finishes to create visual interest. Avoid overly busy patterns and focus on clean, understated designs. Incorporate Open Shelving
Open shelving combines functionality with style, giving your kitchen an airy, modern vibe. Replace a few upper cabinets with floating shelves to display your favorite dishware or decorative items. Choose shelves in wood, metal, or glass to match your overall design. Keep the items you display minimal and organized to avoid a cluttered look. Image source: https://pixabay.com/photos/home-kitchen-interior-5835289/
Modernizing your kitchen doesn't have to mean a complete renovation. By focusing on key areas like cabinetry, lighting, appliances, and surfaces, you can create a sleek, functional space that feels brand new. Start with these six simple changes, and you'll have a modern masterpiece you'll enjoy for years to come.

title: Northern Colorado Drivers to Enjoy Lowest Christmas Gas Prices Since 2020
description: With Christmas just around the corner, Northern Colorado motorists have something to celebrate: the gift of low gas prices. This year, the national average for gasoline is expected to drop to $2.95…
content:
(Photo by Erik Mclean)
With Christmas just around the corner, Northern Colorado motorists have something to celebrate: the gift of low gas prices. This year, the national average for gasoline is expected to drop to $2.95 per gallon on Christmas Day—the lowest holiday price since 2020, according to GasBuddy, a leading fuel savings platform.
After years of soaring prices driven by global economic challenges, a combination of factors has finally brought relief to American drivers. Slower economic growth, higher interest rates from the Federal Reserve, and reduced demand from major oil consumers like China have contributed to a steady decline in fuel prices.
'This holiday season is shaping up to be a gift for American drivers,' said Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy. 'After an exhausting two years of imbalances caused by Covid and geopolitical tensions, we're finally seeing gas prices return to normal. Whether you're visiting family in the mountains or heading across state lines, your wallet will feel a bit heavier.' Why Gas Prices Are Falling
The return to more 'normal' fuel prices marks the end of several years of economic instability, which saw inflation and borrowing costs skyrocket. With global demand easing and oil markets stabilizing, drivers in Northern Colorado and across the country can breathe a sigh of relief. Tips for Holiday Travelers
For those planning road trips over the holidays, GasBuddy recommends checking prices before hitting the road—especially when crossing state lines. Gas taxes can vary significantly, and tools like the GasBuddy app can help travelers find the cheapest fuel nearby. Looking Ahead to 2025
GasBuddy is set to release its 2025 Fuel Outlook later this month, offering insights into trends that could impact drivers' wallets in the year ahead.
As of now, Northern Colorado residents can enjoy this welcome relief, making holiday travels more affordable and leaving a little extra in their budgets for last-minute gifts.

title: Fort Collins Man Found Guilty of Kidnapping and Child Abuse in High-Stakes Standoff
description: A jury has convicted Colten Sirio of multiple felony charges, including first-degree kidnapping, menacing, and child abuse.
content:
A jury has convicted Colten Sirio of multiple felony charges, including first-degree kidnapping, menacing, and child abuse, following a harrowing February 7th standoff near City Park Avenue and West Elizabeth Street in Fort Collins. The incident, which involved a firearm, a female victim, and two young children in a stroller, ended with no harm to the victims thanks to the swift response of Fort Collins Police Services (FCPS). The Incident
On the day of the crime, FCPS officers were alerted to a suspicious man walking alongside a woman pushing a stroller. Upon arrival, officers identified the man as Colten Sirio, already wanted on an active warrant. When officers attempted to arrest Sirio, he brandished a firearm, pointing it at the woman and threatening her life. Refusing to comply with law enforcement commands, Sirio escalated the situation by holding the woman at gunpoint while continuing to walk.
As the standoff unfolded, an officer fired a single shot, striking Sirio in the shoulder. He was then arrested, and the victims, including the two children, were safely rescued. Following protocol, the Larimer County Sheriff's Office activated the 8th Judicial District's Critical Incident Response Team (CIRT) to investigate the officer's actions, later deemed justified by the District Attorney's Office. The Trial
The trial, which began on December 10th, showcased extensive evidence, including video footage of the standoff, phone calls from the victim, and the recovered firearm. Prosecutors Dave Cheval and Lara Maierhofer, specializing in special victims and domestic violence cases, argued that Sirio's actions demonstrated a clear disregard for human life and safety.
After deliberation, the jury found Sirio guilty of the following charges: Three counts of First-Degree Kidnapping (F2): Each carrying a mandatory sentence of 16–48 years in the Department of Corrections (DOC) and fines up to $1,000,000.
Each carrying a mandatory sentence of 16–48 years in the Department of Corrections (DOC) and fines up to $1,000,000. Three counts of Second-Degree Kidnapping (F3): Each with a mandatory sentence of 8–24 years in DOC and fines up to $750,000.
Each with a mandatory sentence of 8–24 years in DOC and fines up to $750,000. One count of Menacing (F5): A sentence of 2–6 years and fines up to $100,000.
A sentence of 2–6 years and fines up to $100,000. Two counts of Reckless Endangerment (M2): Up to 120 days in jail and fines up to $750.
Up to 120 days in jail and fines up to $750. Two counts of Child Abuse (M2): Up to 120 days in jail and fines up to $750. Sentencing and Community Impact
Because Sirio was on parole at the time of the offenses, the charges fall into the aggravated range, with a mandatory minimum sentence of 72 years and a potential maximum of 216 years in prison. Sentencing is scheduled for February 3rd, 2024, at 3:30 p.m. in Courtroom 3B.
This case underscores the diligence of Fort Collins law enforcement and the judicial system in protecting the community. District Attorney Gordon P. McLaughlin commended the coordinated efforts of the police and prosecutors, stating, 'This outcome reflects our commitment to ensuring justice and safety for the residents of Larimer and Jackson counties.' Moving Forward
Residents are reminded that collaboration between law enforcement and the community is crucial in addressing violent crimes. For more information on this case or others, visit Larimer County District Attorney's Office.
Have tips or concerns? Contact the DA's Office at (970) 498-7200 or email [email protected] .

title: Rediscover the Timeless Tragedy of ‘Romeo and Juliet' at Canyon Concert Ballet in Fort Collins
description: Canyon Concert Ballet is set to bring a beloved classic back to life this January with Romeo and Juliet.
content:
FORT COLLINS, CO — Canyon Concert Ballet is set to bring a beloved classic back to life this January with Romeo and Juliet , the timeless story of young love, feuding families, and heartbreaking tragedy. Set against the backdrop of Verona, this stunning ballet—set to Sergei Prokofiev's unforgettable score—offers a fresh opportunity to experience the emotional depth and beauty of Shakespeare's iconic tale.
From January 10-12, 2025, Fort Collins audiences will be transported into the passionate world of Romeo and Juliet at The Lincoln Center. With dramatic choreography, lavish costumes, and breathtaking sets, Canyon Concert Ballet invites viewers to rediscover this legendary love story as though it were the first time. The production promises to be an emotional journey, filled with striking movements and profound moments of love and loss.
A Director's Passion for the Story
Michael Pappalardo, Artistic Director of Canyon Concert Ballet, speaks of Romeo and Juliet with deep reverence. 'This ballet holds a special place in my heart because it combines the raw beauty of dance with one of the greatest love stories ever told,' says Pappalardo. 'The music, the movement, and the emotion create a world where love and tragedy intertwine, reminding us why ballet is such a powerful art form.'
The tragic tale centers on the forbidden love between Romeo Montague and Juliet Capulet, two young lovers caught in the bitter feud between their families. Secretly married, their lives take a devastating turn when Juliet takes a potion to appear dead in order to escape an arranged marriage. Believing she has truly passed, Romeo takes his own life, and upon waking, Juliet does the same. The ballet's beauty lies not only in its choreography but in the raw human emotions of love, conflict, and sacrifice that still resonate today.
Pappalardo continues, 'The story is eternal—love, conflict, and sacrifice are as relevant today as they were centuries ago. Every time I revisit this ballet, I discover something new to share with audiences. It's a deeply human and profoundly moving experience.'
A Spectacular Performance for Northern Colorado
Whether you're a longtime fan of the ballet or experiencing it for the first time, Canyon Concert Ballet's Romeo and Juliet promises to captivate audiences with its emotional intensity and stunning performances. The production will be performed at The Lincoln Center in Fort Collins on: Friday, January 10, 2025 at 7:00 PM
at 7:00 PM Saturday, January 11, 2025 at 2:00 PM and 7:00 PM
at 2:00 PM and 7:00 PM Sunday, January 12, 2025 at 2:00 PM
Tickets are available for purchase now through the Lincoln Center website at https://tickets.lctix.com/eventperformances.asp?evt=2047.
For Northern Colorado residents, this production offers the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in a world where dance, drama, and music converge in one of ballet's most beloved works. Don't miss this chance to experience the enduring power of Romeo and Juliet —a story of love, loss, and fate that continues to captivate audiences across generations.
Note: Make sure to secure your tickets early as performances are expected to sell out quickly!

title: Loveland Police Launch Photo Speed and Red-Light Enforcement
description: The Loveland Police Department (LPD) is introducing photo speed and red-light enforcement measures starting January 15, 2025.
content:
(Photo from shutterstock.com)
In an effort to curb speeding and improve traffic safety, the Loveland Police Department (LPD) is introducing photo speed and red-light enforcement measures starting January 15, 2025. These advanced systems aim to address traffic violations in areas identified as high-risk for accidents, providing a technological edge to enforcement. New Safety Measures Coming to Loveland
Mobile photo radar enforcement will soon be deployed in qualifying areas to deter excessive speeding, while red-light cameras will be installed at key intersections across Loveland. Initial red-light enforcement locations include: E. Eisenhower Blvd. at Boise Avenue
W. 1st Street at Taft Avenue
N. Garfield Avenue at E. 57th Street
The locations were chosen through collaboration between the LPD and the city's Traffic Operations Department. Factors such as traffic volume, collision and injury data, recurring complaints, and the challenges of in-person enforcement played a role in the selection. How the Program Works
Once operational, red-light cameras will document violations that are later reviewed by LPD staff. Drivers caught running red lights will receive a civil infraction citation, resulting in a $75 fine with no points added to their driver's license.
Mobile photo radar systems, which will operate in school zones, construction areas, residential neighborhoods, and near municipal parks, will address speeding violations with fines of $40. These efforts focus on areas prone to collisions and frequent speeding complaints.
Violations captured by either system will first generate a warning during a 30-day grace period starting January 15. After this period, citations with fines will be mailed to vehicle owners, who will have the option to pay or dispute the charges in court. Why It Matters for Loveland
Both programs aim to address two critical issues: speeding and red-light violations, which are leading contributors to accidents and near-misses. By leveraging technology, LPD seeks to enhance road safety for all residents and visitors in Loveland.
'The addition of these tools helps us address violations that are otherwise difficult to enforce in person,' LPD stated in a press release. 'Reducing excessive speeding and red-light violations will make our streets safer for everyone.' Stay Updated
LPD will continue to provide updates as the systems roll out. For more information on the program and traffic safety in Loveland, visit the Loveland Police Department's website.
Have feedback about speeding or red-light concerns in your neighborhood? Residents are encouraged to share their input with LPD as the program evolves.
Make sure to drive cautiously and stay informed about these new measures to avoid citations—and to contribute to safer streets for Northern Colorado.

title: Paint, Play, Inspire: Pianos About Town Seeks New Artists and Piano Donations in 2025
description: The iconic Pianos About Town program, a beloved fusion of public art and music in Fort Collins, is on the hunt for fresh talent and piano donations for its 2025 season.
content:
PHOTO COURTESY BOHEMIAN FOUNDATION. Piano painted by Amelia Caruso
FORT COLLINS, Colo. — The iconic Pianos About Town program, a beloved fusion of public art and music in Fort Collins, is on the hunt for fresh talent and piano donations for its 2025 season. This unique initiative invites artists of all backgrounds to transform pianos into stunning works of art while offering the public a chance to enjoy both the creative process and spontaneous musical expression around town. Call for Artists: A Canvas with Keys
Pianos About Town is seeking diverse artists and concepts, with a focus on emerging talent and innovative designs. Selected artists will receive a $1,000 honorarium for their work. To apply, artists or teams must submit a letter of intent along with a concept rendering by Feb. 19, 2025, before 4 p.m. MST. Applications are reviewed and selected by the City of Fort Collins Art in Public Places committee.
The program encourages artists to attend two optional virtual sessions for guidance: Virtual Presentation and Q&A:
Date: Jan. 29, 6:30–7:30 p.m.
Learn about the application process and participate in a live Q&A with program staff.
Jan. 29, 6:30–7:30 p.m. Learn about the application process and participate in a live Q&A with program staff. One-On-One Application Review:
Date: Feb. 12, 2–6:30 p.m. (by appointment)
Get personalized feedback and recommendations to enhance your application.
For more details and to apply, visit fcgov.com/art-calls. Donate a Piano, Inspire a Community
The program also relies on community-donated pianos, which serve as the 'canvas' for these artistic transformations. If you own a full-size upright piano in good working condition (at least 48 inches tall), consider donating it to this program. Professional movers will collect qualifying pianos free of charge in Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, Wellington, and nearby areas.
To donate, email a photo of the piano to Liz Good, Visual Arts Coordinator for the City of Fort Collins, at [email protected] or call (970) 416-2646. About Pianos About Town
Since its inception in 2010, Pianos About Town has brought art, music, and community spirit to the streets of Fort Collins. Modeled after similar projects, including a global initiative by British artist Luke Jerram and Denver's 16th Street Mall installation, the program has become a local treasure. It provides paid opportunities for visual artists, enhances public spaces with vibrant artwork, and creates moments of joy through impromptu music performances.
A collaboration among the City of Fort Collins Art in Public Places Program, the Downtown Development Authority, and the Bohemian Foundation, Pianos About Town continues to enrich the cultural landscape of Northern Colorado.
Follow the journey of these musical masterpieces on Facebook and Instagram for updates, artist highlights, and more.
Whether you're an artist ready to make your mark, a piano owner with an instrument to share, or simply a fan of the arts, Pianos About Town invites you to join in the celebration of creativity and community.
For more information, visit fcgov.com/pianos.

title: The Legal Value of Police Reports as Evidence in Car Accidents
author: Blaine Howerton
description: After a car crash occurs and blame needs to be assigned afterward, it usually depends on the evidence that's accessible at the scene and beyond it. One of the key pieces of evidence in such [...]
content:
After a car crash occurs and blame needs to be assigned afterward, it usually depends on the evidence that's accessible at the scene and beyond it. One of the key pieces of evidence in such situations is the police report, which carries considerable importance. These reports provide an overview of what happened during the incident and offer information that can play a key role in any legal actions taken. Having an understanding of how significant police reports are in car accident cases can assist those involved in making informed decisions more confidently. The Significance of Police Reports
Police reports act as documentation of the incident, prepared by law enforcement personnel at the site of the accident. These reports usually include details such as the date and time of the incident, its location, and testimonies from drivers, passengers, and bystanders. Furthermore, officers note their observations about vehicle damages, weather conditions, and any traffic infractions that may have occurred. This detailed evidence for car accident overview assists in piecing together what happened and confirming the facts of the situation. The Concept of Reliability and Impartiality
Police reports hold value due to their reliability and impartiality in assessing accident scenes, based on evidence and witness statements provided by law enforcement officers who undergo thorough training for this purpose. You can depend upon these reports as sources of information frequently utilized by insurance companies and legal practitioners to evaluate claims and assign responsibility. Involvement in Insurance Claims
Insurance companies heavily depend on police reports when assessing accident claims, as these reports offer a foundation for comprehending the situation surrounding the incident. Adjusters utilize the details to ascertain the level of damages incurred and to evaluate fault in order to make decisions on compensation. A thorough police report often streamlines the claims process and facilitates settlements for those involved. The Impact on Proceedings
During court proceedings regarding car accident cases, police reports influence the case to an extent. The reports themselves may not be directly presented as evidence, but they serve a purpose in strengthening other evidence provided during the trial. Legal representatives frequently use these reports to validate witness testimonies and point out any discrepancies or contradictions in statements made by others. The impartial viewpoint presented in these reports is highly appreciated by judges and jury members, as it can influence their decisions in favor of the party supported by the documentation. Challenges Associated with Law Enforcement Documents
Even though police reports play a significant role in investigations and legal processes, they do come with limitations. Police officers may not always witness an accident themselves and often depend on statements provided by those involved and witnesses. This reliance on second-hand information can sometimes result in inconsistencies or gaps in the report. Furthermore, mistakes like missing details or inaccurate information can affect the report's reliability. It's crucial for individuals involved in an accident to review these reports and promptly notify the authorities of any inaccuracies found. Boosting the Worth of the Report
To increase the significance of a police report after an accident, it's advisable for those involved to be proactive. Offering statements to the officer aids in creating an accurate record. Furthermore, obtaining contact details from witnesses and capturing images of the location can add depth to the report. These measures improve the quality of evidence overall, bolstering the argument in insurance assessments. Other Types of Proof
Police reports play an important role in investigations but are not the only source of information needed to understand the whole situation properly. Other evidence, like records, photos, and testimonies, can provide more support to the claims made. By combining these pieces of evidence, a clearer and more complete picture of what happened can be formed, which allows for a more detailed investigation and fairer outcome to be achieved. Summary
Police reports are crucial in car accident scenarios, as they provide an impartial description of the event, serving as a resource for insurance claims and legal matters alike. It's important to recognize the boundaries of these reports and supplement them with additional evidence to construct a stronger case. Utilizing the insights from these reports allows individuals involved to seek fairness and rightful compensation following an accident.

title: Loveland Police Investigate Road Rage Shooting Near Taft Avenue and 57th Street
description: A road rage incident escalated into gunfire in Loveland on Friday, December 27, 2024, prompting a swift response from local law enforcement.
content:
Photo courtesy of Loveland Police Department
Loveland, CO – A road rage incident escalated into gunfire in Loveland on Friday, December 27, 2024, prompting a swift response from local law enforcement. The Loveland Police Department reported that a firearm was discharged during a dispute between two motorists traveling north on Taft Avenue, near 57th Street.
Multiple rounds struck the victim's vehicle, but no injuries were reported. The suspected shooter, identified as 23-year-old Brice Carey, allegedly fled the scene toward Fort Collins after the incident.
Police temporarily closed the roadway to collect evidence, and detectives, with support from the Larimer County Sheriff's Office, quickly identified Carey and his vehicle. Authorities monitored his residence before arresting him and establishing probable cause.
Carey was booked into the Larimer County Jail on several felony charges, including: Second-Degree Murder (Heat of Passion)
(Heat of Passion) Criminal Attempt to Commit a Class Three Felony
Menacing with a Firearm
Tampering with Physical Evidence
Details regarding bail were not available at the time of publication. The Loveland Police Department urges anyone with information about the incident to contact their Tip Line at (970) 962-2032 or Larimer County Crime Stoppers at (970) 221-6868. Community Reminder
While no injuries occurred, the incident serves as a stark reminder of the dangers of escalating road rage. Drivers are encouraged to remain calm and prioritize safety on Northern Colorado's busy roads.
The listed charges are accusations, and Carey is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

title: Is AI Empowering the Rise of One-Person Digital Agencies
description: For businesses looking to gain visibility, leads, and sales without marketing experience, hiring a professional marketing agency is the smartest move. In the digital era, online presence is non…
content:
For businesses looking to gain visibility, leads, and sales without marketing experience, hiring a professional marketing agency is the smartest move. In the digital era, online presence is non-negotiable for survival and growth, making digital marketing agencies a vital resource for businesses of all sizes.
These sometimes small teams have a tremendous impact, and they can do wonders with often very limited budgets. But their world is changing – due to AI. It is no longer a distant prospect – AI is here, changing the entire world. And every profession in it.
While it is evident that AI and automation will cause the loss of many jobs, they will also open opportunities for many former employees to become solopreneurs – doing workloads of entire agencies.
Well, this is at least the narrative that AI companies are pushing – creating opportunities, not shutting down jobs. How true is it?
Is this really the best time to start a one-person digital marketing agency? One-Person Digital Marketing Agencies: Opportunities and Challenges
Does AI create more opportunities than it takes away? This article will explore some of the benefits and challenges of venturing into solopreneurship in digital marketing. Key Services Offered by Digital Agencies
Digital marketing agencies help businesses grow online through SEO , content creation, and social media campaigns. They also manage PPC ads on platforms like Google, run email marketing campaigns, and offer web design and CRO services to optimize performance. With analytics and reporting to guide decisions, agencies provide a complete solution for boosting online visibility and driving results. The AI Tools Transforming Digital Agencies
AI tools are automating tasks that were once labor-intensive and time-consuming. In practice, these are the tasks usually done by interns or juniors. Here are some key areas where AI is making a difference: Content Generation
Generative writing tools like Jasper and Copy.ai allow marketers to quickly create content, from blog posts to ad copy, while tools like Grammarly ensure polished, error-free writing. SEO Optimization
AI tools such as SEMrush and Ahrefs simplify keyword research, track backlinks, and identify opportunities for improving search rankings. Social Media Management
Tools like Buffer and Hootsuite automate social media scheduling, track engagement, and provide insights to refine strategies. Analytics and Reporting
AI-powered platforms like Google Analytics and Tableau provide actionable insights, helping marketers make data-driven decisions without needing a dedicated analytics team. Drawbacks of AI tools
While AI tools are groundbreaking, they remain just tools, dependent on human operators. Without careful oversight, they can cause significant issues, especially as AI lacks true contextual understanding. Tasks like keyword research, analytics, and content creation often require heavy editing to correct inaccuracies.
Another pressing issue is long-term: if entry-level roles are replaced by AI, who will gain the experience to lead and innovate as senior professionals in the future? If you're planning to scale your business (a fundamental goal for success), who will you delegate tasks to? Advantages of One-Person Agencies
There are plenty of advantages of 'solo marketing agencies': 1. Efficiency
Automation handles essential tasks like email marketing, lead tracking, and campaign analysis, reducing reliance on large teams. Without the need for extensive meetings or approvals, decisions are quicker, and ideas stay true to their original form. Less back-and-forth between departments means more time for focused, productive work. 2. Cost Savings
With minimal overhead costs, solo marketers can offer competitive pricing while maximizing their profit margins. 3. Flexibility
Solopreneurs can adapt quickly to market changes, tailoring their services to client needs without larger agencies' endless meetings and bureaucracy. Challenges of Going Solo
While the one-person agency model has its perks, it also comes with significant challenges: 1. Scalability
As client demands grow, managing multiple campaigns can become overwhelming for one person. Again, we circle back to the question – will we have mediors and seniors in 10 years if we leave all junior tasks to AI? 2. Skill Gaps
Even with AI, mastering every aspect of digital marketing (design, copywriting, SEO, and analytics) is difficult (if not almost impossible) 3. Burnout Risk
Taking on too much responsibility without support can lead to overwork and diminished creativity. One thing is common for every client – their milestones are the same (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, end of year, etc). And they will all demand results at the same time. The Role of Strategic Outsourcing
No man is an island, and the same goes for business. We live in a global village, and talent is everywhere. If you can't do a task properly (due to the lack of skills or resources), it is better to outsource it – especially if the task requires a human approach and personal connections. For instance, cold pitching high-ticket clients or link building.
Link building is a critical component of SEO that requires expertise and time. Partnering with a white label link building company allows one-person agencies to deliver quality backlinks to clients without handling the entire process themselves. A New Era in Digital Marketing
The question isn't whether one-person agencies are possible – niche, specialized agencies clearly are. The real question is whether this approach will become the dominant model in digital marketing or coexist alongside traditional agencies. Either way, the rise of AI ensures that solo entrepreneurs will continue to significantly impact the industry's future.

title: Them Dirty Roses Bring Southern Rock Heat to the Aggie Theatre
description: by Blaine Howerton | NorthFortyNews.com Fort Collins, get ready—Them Dirty Roses are coming to town. Born and raised in the heart of Alabama, these Southern rockers are set to deliver a high-energy…
content:
Them Dirty Roses live in France (Photo courtesy https://www.themdirtyroses.com/)
by Blaine Howerton | NorthFortyNews.com
Fort Collins, get ready—Them Dirty Roses are coming to town. Born and raised in the heart of Alabama, these Southern rockers are set to deliver a high-energy performance at the Aggie Theatre, showcasing their authentic sound and undeniable stage presence.
Hailing from Gadsden, AL, Them Dirty Roses embodies everything that makes Southern rock unforgettable. Brothers James and Frank Ford, along with lifelong friends Andrew Davis and Ben Crain, grew up steeped in the sounds of Lynyrd Skynyrd and Hank Williams. This rich musical heritage, combined with their gritty storytelling, forms the backbone of their unique style.
Their journey began when they loaded up an RV with nothing but their instruments and dreams, heading to Nashville to chase the quintessential rock-and-roll American dream. title: Larimer County Shares Information on Sexually Violent Predator to Enhance Public Safety
description: The Larimer County Sheriff's Office (LCSO) has announced the release of information regarding a Sexually Violent Predator (SVP) now residing in the community. The notification, required under Colorado…
content:
The Larimer County Sheriff's Office (LCSO) has announced the release of information regarding a Sexually Violent Predator (SVP) now residing in the community. The notification, required under Colorado law, will be available online from January 10 through January 24, 2025. This initiative aims to enhance public safety and awareness, ensuring residents have access to essential information while maintaining the rights of the individual involved. Why This Matters to Northern Colorado
The notification aligns with the Colorado Revised Statutes (16-13-901 through 16-13-905), which mandate active community engagement in cases involving SVPs. Rather than hosting an in-person meeting, the LCSO has opted to make the details available online for broader accessibility. What You Need to Know
Residents are encouraged to review the information provided online but are advised to exercise discretion when sharing it with children. Parents should review the notification first to understand the details and then discuss relevant safety topics with their children.
Sheriff's Office officials stress that the notification is strictly for public safety. Any use of this information to intimidate, harass, or threaten the offender or others involved in the process is a criminal act and will not be tolerated. Understanding SVP Notifications
Under federal and state regulations, local law enforcement must notify the public about sexually violent predators to promote transparency and safety. The Jacob Wetterling Act of 1994 permits law enforcement to share such information with the community, and the designation of an SVP requires this heightened level of notification.
It's important to note that law enforcement cannot dictate where an offender lives unless court-ordered restrictions are in place. As a result, the offender is free to reside in any location of their choosing within constitutional boundaries. How to Access Information
Details about the offender, including public safety tips, can be found on the Larimer County Sheriff's website at larimer.gov/spotlights/2025/01/10/sexually-violent-predator-notification. Those with further questions are encouraged to contact Investigative Technician Harry Bowen at 970-498-5142.
The Larimer County Sheriff's Office remains committed to protecting the community while respecting legal and constitutional guidelines. Stay informed, stay safe, and take proactive steps to discuss these issues with your family.

title: How to Choose the Right Accounting and Advisory Services for Your SMSF Management
description: Managing a Self-Managed Super Fund (SMSF) can be a rewarding yet complex endeavor. To ensure your SMSF operates smoothly, making the right choice of accounting and advisory services is crucial. A…
content:
Image Credit
Managing a Self-Managed Super Fund (SMSF) can be a rewarding yet complex endeavor. To ensure your SMSF operates smoothly, making the right choice of accounting and advisory services is crucial. A trusted team of professionals can provide the expertise and guidance necessary to navigate the regulatory landscape, maximize returns, and avoid costly mistakes. But with so many options available, how do you pick the right one?
In this post, we'll explore six key factors to consider when choosing accounting and advisory services for your SMSF management. Whether you're new to SMSFs or looking to switch service providers, these tips will help you make an informed decision to safeguard your financial future and optimize your retirement savings. Let's get started. Assess the Firm's Expertise and Industry Experience
When choosing accounting and advisory services for your SMSF, experience is a critical factor. You want to work with professionals who are not only familiar with the intricacies of SMSF regulations but also have a deep understanding of the financial landscape and market trends. As highlighted by the team behind SMSF Australia , experienced accounting and advisory services will have a proven track record of helping clients navigate complex rules and optimize their investment strategies. They will provide valuable insights into tax planning, help you structure your SMSF investments for optimal returns, and ensure your fund remains compliant with evolving regulations.
Their expertise can also help you avoid common pitfalls and costly mistakes that can arise from mismanagement or lack of knowledge. With an experienced team, you can feel confident that your SMSF is being managed with the highest level of professionalism, safeguarding your retirement savings and maximizing the potential for growth. Evaluate the Range of Services Offered
The right accounting and advisory service should provide a comprehensive range of services tailored to the unique needs of your SMSF. These services might include tax advice, audit assistance, investment strategy development, and compliance monitoring. The more diverse their offerings, the better they can help you manage all aspects of your fund in a seamless, integrated manner.
It's important to assess whether the firm can support your long-term financial goals with customized advice. A good service provider will work with you to create a strategy that aligns with your retirement objectives and ensures you remain compliant with the changing laws surrounding SMSFs. Look for Transparency and Clear Communication
Transparency in fees and services is a non-negotiable factor when selecting accounting and advisory services for your SMSF. Choose a firm that is upfront about its fees, outlining what is included and any additional charges that might arise. Clear communication is equally important, as you'll need to be kept informed about the status of your fund, any regulatory changes, and new investment opportunities.
Make sure the firm is proactive in providing updates and answering your questions, ensuring you understand the financial direction of your SMSF. A transparent service provider builds trust and helps you feel confident about your financial decisions. Check for SMSF Specialization and Compliance Knowledge
Not all accountants and financial advisors are well-versed in SMSFs, so it's crucial to select a firm that specializes in this area. SMSFs come with a specific set of rules and requirements that require focused knowledge and attention. Ensure the team has expertise in SMSF compliance, including regulatory updates from bodies such as the Australian Taxation Office (ATO).
They should be up-to-date with changes in laws that could impact your fund's structure or investment options. A specialized team can provide tailored advice, from fund establishment to ongoing management, ensuring your SMSF remains in good standing while achieving your financial goals. Consider the Firm's Approach to Technology and Innovation
In today's digital age, leveraging technology is essential for efficient SMSF management. Choose an accounting and advisory service that uses modern tools to streamline the management of your fund. This could include online portals for easy access to your SMSF's financial information, cloud-based accounting software for real-time updates, and secure document sharing systems.
Technology can enhance the accuracy and efficiency of reporting, making it easier for both you and your advisor to track performance, expenses, and compliance. A firm that embraces innovation is more likely to offer quicker, more efficient solutions to manage your SMSF effectively. Read Client Reviews and Testimonials for Insights
One of the best ways to gauge the quality of accounting and advisory services is by looking at client feedback. Seek out online reviews, testimonials, and case studies that can offer insight into the experiences of other SMSF clients. Positive reviews from satisfied customers are a good indicator of reliable service and a high level of client satisfaction.
It's also beneficial to ask the firm directly for references from clients with similar needs. By reading reviews and speaking with past clients, you can better understand the firm's strengths, weaknesses, and the overall quality of service provided. Image Credit
Choosing the right accounting and advisory services for your SMSF is essential to achieving long-term financial security and compliance. By assessing a firm's expertise, evaluating their range of services, ensuring transparency, and considering their use of technology, you can make an informed decision. Working with a specialized team will help you navigate complex regulations and optimize your fund's performance. Ultimately, selecting the right professionals will give you peace of mind, knowing that your SMSF is being managed efficiently, with your best interests at heart, and with a focus on securing your retirement future.

title: Larimer County's Marina Slip Lottery Returns: Your Chance to Dock at Horsetooth and Carter Lake
description: Northern Colorado boaters, it's time to secure your spot at two of the region's favorite water destinations. The Larimer County Department of Natural Resources (LCDNR) has officially opened its second…
content:
Image courtesy of campoutcolorado.com
Northern Colorado boaters, it's time to secure your spot at two of the region's favorite water destinations. The Larimer County Department of Natural Resources (LCDNR) has officially opened its second annual marina slip lottery for Horsetooth Reservoir's Inlet Bay Marina and Carter Lake Marina. If you're dreaming of docking your boat at these picturesque locations, now is the time to act! What You Need to Know About the Lottery
The lottery, which runs from January 1 through February 28, 2025, provides an equitable process for securing boat slips. LCDNR introduced this system in 2024 to meet increasing demand and ensure fairness for all applicants.
Winning the lottery doesn't guarantee a slip, but it does provide the chance to proceed to the application process, which includes an interview and vetting by marina staff. How to Enter
Participating in the lottery is free and straightforward. Here's how: Submit your entry before February 28 at 11:59 p.m. through the official LCDNR website: Marina Slip Lottery Entry. Lottery winners will be chosen through a random number generator by March 15, 2025. Selected participants will be contacted by the respective marinas to begin the application process.
It's important to note that available slip inventory depends on spaces left after returning customers in good standing are accommodated. Entries do not carry over to subsequent years, so interested boaters must reapply annually. A Fair and Free Process
While there's no fee to participate, LCDNR requests that only serious applicants apply to maintain an efficient process for everyone involved. About Larimer County's Marinas
Horsetooth Reservoir and Carter Lake are beloved for their breathtaking scenery and excellent boating opportunities. From early morning fishing trips to afternoon cruises, these locations offer unmatched recreational experiences in Northern Colorado. About Larimer County Department of Natural Resources
Since 1954, the LCDNR has worked to connect the community with nature through land conservation and recreational access. With over 57,000 acres of protected land and 13 public properties available for enjoyment, the department continues to enrich the lives of Larimer County residents.
For more details on the marina slip lottery or other outdoor opportunities, visit Larimer County Natural Resources.
Don't miss your chance to secure a coveted marina slip at one of Northern Colorado's top boating destinations! Enter the lottery today and make 2025 a year to remember on the water.

title: Northern Colorado Weather: Winter Weather Advisory, Snow and Frigid Temperatures Ahead
description: by Blaine Howerton | NorthFortyNews.com Winter has officially tightened its grip on Northern Colorado, and over the next three days, we're in for freezing temperatures, snow showers, and plenty of…
content:
January 16, 2025 admin News 0 (Photo from pxhere.com)
by Blaine Howerton | NorthFortyNews.com
Winter has officially tightened its grip on Northern Colorado, and over the next three days, we're in for freezing temperatures, snow showers, and plenty of reasons to bundle up. Here's the most up-to-date forecast for Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, Wellington, Red Feather Lakes, Timnath, Bellvue, and Livermore. I've pulled the latest details from NOAA and the National Weather Service to keep us all prepared.
Friday kicks off cloudy and cool, with daytime highs only reaching 17°F to 20°F across most of the region. Fort Collins, Windsor, and Loveland will hover just below 20°F, while areas like Livermore and Red Feather Lakes may stay closer to 15°F.
By late afternoon, snow will begin falling, with an 80–90% chance of precipitation lasting into the night. Accumulations of 2–4 inches are expected in lower elevations, with up to 6 inches possible near the foothills. Winds will shift from west to north-northeast at 8–13 mph, bringing gusts up to 20 mph. Overnight lows will plummet to 8°F or lower, so watch for icy roads and prepare for a slick commute. Saturday, January 18: Snow Tapers Off but the Cold Intensifies
Saturday morning may bring lingering snow flurries, especially in the foothills around Bellvue and Livermore, but by midday, skies will begin to clear. Total snow accumulations should range between 3–6 inches region-wide, with higher amounts in the foothills.
Temperatures will stay brutally cold, with highs only reaching 10°F to 14°F in most areas. Wind chills will make it feel closer to 0°F. By nightfall, expect lows around -5°F to -10°F, with Red Feather Lakes and Livermore experiencing the coldest conditions. Sunday, January 19: Sunshine Returns but Temperatures Stay Frigid
Sunday will bring some much-needed sunshine, but don't let it fool you—it's going to stay cold. Highs will range from 12°F to 15°F in Fort Collins, Loveland, and Windsor, with Red Feather Lakes and Wellington staying closer to 10°F. Winds will remain calm, but the bitter cold will linger, with overnight lows once again dipping below zero. What to Expect Around the Region Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, and Timnath : Snow Friday night into Saturday morning; bitter cold with clearing skies through Sunday.
: Snow Friday night into Saturday morning; bitter cold with clearing skies through Sunday. Wellington and Bellvue : Similar snow accumulations as the lower elevations, but expect more frigid conditions Saturday and Sunday.
: Similar snow accumulations as the lower elevations, but expect more frigid conditions Saturday and Sunday. Livermore and Red Feather Lakes: Heaviest snow accumulations Friday night and the coldest temperatures throughout the weekend. Prepare for lows near -10°F. Winter Weather Advisory
The National Weather Service has issued a Winter Weather Advisory for Northern Colorado from Friday afternoon through Saturday evening. Hazardous travel conditions are likely due to snow-packed roads and rapidly dropping temperatures, especially Friday night. For up-to-date road conditions, visit cotrip.org or dial 511.
While the snow may bring challenges, it also brings beauty. Whether you're admiring the snow-covered foothills or cozying up indoors, stay warm and enjoy the winter wonderland. For the latest weather updates, visit NOAA.gov.
Stay safe, Northern Colorado!

title: Kinn Thai Cuisine: A Flavorful Escape in Fort Collins
description: Nestled in the heart of Fort Collins, Kinn Thai Cuisine offers a vibrant culinary experience that transports you straight to Southeast Asia.
content:
Kinn Thai Fort Collins, Tom Kha HotPot (Photo by Blaine Howerton)
by Blaine Howerton | NorthFortyNews.com
Nestled in the heart of Fort Collins, Kinn Thai Cuisine offers a vibrant culinary experience that transports you straight to Southeast Asia. On my recent visit, I was captivated by the restaurant's warm ambiance and tantalizing menu. Here's my take on the dishes I tried.
Charsu Bun
I started with the Charsu Bun, a light and flavorful appetizer that set the tone for the meal. The fluffy steamed bun paired beautifully with the savory and slightly sweet charsu pork. The balance of textures was spot-on, making this dish a delightful beginning. Kinn Thai Fort Collins, Charsu Bun (Photo by Blaine Howerton)
Golden Fire Calamari
Next up was the Golden Fire Calamari. Lightly breaded and fried to perfection, the calamari was tender and complemented by a zesty dipping sauce with a subtle kick. It was a harmonious blend of crunch and spice, making it a must-try for seafood lovers. Kinn Thai Fort Collins, Golden Fire Calamari (Photo by Blaine Howerton)
Tom Kha Hot Pot
For the soup course, I opted for the Tom Kha Hot Pot. This dish was the star of the meal. The rich coconut milk base, infused with lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves, delivered an explosion of flavors. The broth's creamy texture and aromatic spices made each spoonful comforting and satisfying. Generous portions of chicken and mushrooms added heartiness to this traditional Thai favorite.
Avocado Curry and Coconut Rice
Finally, I indulged in the Avocado Curry, paired with a side of Coconut Rice. The curry's creamy texture, enhanced by the unique addition of avocado, brought a twist to the classic dish. The mild sweetness of the coconut rice perfectly complemented the rich and slightly spicy curry, creating a well-rounded and satisfying plate. Kinn Thai Fort Collins Avocado Curry with a side of Coconut Rice (Photo by Blaine Howerton)
Overall Experience
The total cost of $60.20 felt like a fair price for the quality and variety of the dishes. The service was attentive, and the staff's knowledge of the menu added a personal touch to the experience.
Kinn Thai Cuisine is a gem in Fort Collins, ideal for both casual dinners and special occasions. Whether you're a fan of traditional Thai dishes or looking to try something with a modern twist, this spot won't disappoint.
For anyone craving an authentic and flavorful journey, I highly recommend giving Kinn Thai Cuisine a try. It's located at 2638 S. Timberline Rd. More information is on their website at kinnthaicuisine.com.

title: 40.5-Year Sentence for Loveland Murder Highlights Justice for Victims, Community Healing
description: Support Northern Colorado Journalism Show your support for North Forty News by helping us produce more content. It's a kind and simple gesture that will help us continue to bring more content to you.…
content:
North Forty News file photo.
Fort Collins, CO — Justice was served in a Larimer County courtroom on January 16 as Oscar Perez Jr. was sentenced to 40.5 years in the Department of Corrections. Perez, now 18, pled guilty to second-degree murder, two counts of attempted second-degree murder, and one count of menacing, stemming from a tragic 2023 shooting at Loveland's Brookstone Apartments.
The crimes occurred on January 20, 2023, when Perez, then 15, fatally shot 19-year-old Nasier Graham, a beloved member of the Loveland community, and injured another teenager. Perez also attempted to kill a second teen during the incident. The senseless act of violence left the community mourning the loss of a promising young man known for his positivity and leadership. The Case and Sentencing
After a contested hearing, Perez was transferred from the juvenile to the adult criminal justice system—a rare decision in the 8th Judicial District. Prosecutors argued that the severity of the crimes demanded accountability beyond what the juvenile system could provide.
During sentencing, Larimer County District Judge Daniel McDonald drew a stark contrast between the victim and the perpetrator. 'Nasier was a leader who made the people around him better, bringing joy and hope,' McDonald stated. 'Oscar, on the other hand, was a leader who brought pain and despair.'
Chief Deputy District Attorney Robert Axmacher emphasized the senselessness of the crimes, describing them as proof of the challenges posed by violence. 'This case is proof that evil exists in this world,' Axmacher said. 'But as a community, we refuse to let evil win—good will prevail.' Remembering Nasier Graham
Nasier Graham was remembered during the sentencing by family, friends, and community members who shared heartfelt tributes to his life and legacy. Detective Clint Schnorr, who led the investigation, spoke emotionally about the case. 'Nasier was a remarkable man—someone who made a positive impact on everyone around him,' Schnorr said.
District Attorney Gordon McLaughlin echoed these sentiments, expressing hope that the sentence would help the victims' families find closure. 'While the random and senseless nature of this murder shocks the conscience, today's sentencing is a testament to Nasier's character and the community's resilience,' McLaughlin said. Addressing Gun Violence
This case serves as a stark reminder of the devastating consequences of gun violence. Local organizations like the Larimer County Juvenile Gun Safety Coalition, Safe2Tell Colorado, and Moms Demand Action continue to work toward preventing such tragedies in Northern Colorado.
For more information about gun violence prevention, visit:
This tragic incident underscores the need for continued efforts to foster safety and equity in Northern Colorado communities.

Maintaining sound financial and accounting systems.
Demonstrating a proven ability to deliver emergency services.

title: Detectives Seek Public's Help to Solve Death of 22 Month Old Brooklyn Digesualdo
author: Blaine Howerton
description: In January 2000, a heartbreaking tragedy struck the Northern Colorado community. The Weld County Sheriff's Department seeks answers.
content:
by Blaine Howerton | NorthFortyNews.com
In January 2000, a heartbreaking tragedy struck the Northern Colorado community when 22-month-old Brooklyn Digesualdo died under suspicious circumstances. Now, more than two decades later, Weld County Sheriff's Office (WCSO) detectives are determined to uncover the truth and bring closure to Brooklyn's family. Brooklyn Digesualdo (Graphic Courtesy Weld County Sheriff's Office)
On January 22, 2000, Brooklyn was left in the care of her mother's boyfriend, Miguel Sirio, at their home in unincorporated Frederick, Colorado, while her mother ran an errand. According to Sirio, Brooklyn reportedly fell off a bed while he was out of the room, and shortly after, he found her unresponsive.
Brooklyn was rushed to Children's Hospital in Denver but tragically passed away. Despite extensive medical evaluations, her cause of death was never determined, and detectives suspect foul play in this case.
WCSO Cold Case Detective Byron Kastilahn is now calling on the community for assistance in piecing together what happened to Brooklyn. Detectives are particularly interested in speaking with Miguel Sirio, who was last known to be homeless in the Denver area.
If you have any information about Miguel Sirio's whereabouts or details regarding Brooklyn Digesualdo's death, you are urged to come forward. Tips can be shared through the WCSO tip line at (970) 304-6464 or via email at [email protected] .
The Northern Colorado community has the opportunity to help bring answers to Brooklyn's family, who have waited far too long for justice. Let's come together to ensure her story isn't forgotten.
For more information about the Weld County Sheriff's Office and its ongoing cases, visit their official website.
Note: All charges are allegations, and individuals are considered innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

title: Discover the Genius of Pablo Picasso at the Longmont Museum's New Exhibit
description: The Longmont Museum in Northern Colorado invites art enthusiasts and curious minds to embark on an extraordinary journey through the works of Pablo Picasso with their latest exhibit, 'A Graphic…
content:
The Painter with the Palette - Picasso - (Image courtesy Longmont Museum)
The Longmont Museum in Northern Colorado invites art enthusiasts and curious minds to embark on an extraordinary journey through the works of Pablo Picasso with their latest exhibit, 'A Graphic Journey: Prints by Pablo Picasso.' Running from January 31 through May 4, 2025, this exhibit offers a rare opportunity to delve into the iconic artist's printmaking evolution and creative genius.
Featuring over 60 works spanning five decades (1923–1972), the exhibit explores three pivotal stages of Picasso's career. Visitors will marvel at his early etchings, bold lithographs, and inventive linocuts, showcasing his collaborations with renowned printmakers Georges Lacourière, Fernand Mourlot, and Hidalgo Arnera.
In addition to prints, the exhibit includes original ceramics created by Picasso, generously loaned by a local collector, offering a deeper understanding of his artistic versatility.
Kick off the exhibition with a Parisian-inspired evening on Friday, January 31, from 6–8 p.m. Guests will enjoy live piano music featuring French composer Erik Satie, elegant cocktail attire, and the ambiance of 20th-century Paris. Personal charcuterie plates and signature French cocktails will be available. Tickets are $8 for adults and $5 for students and seniors, with free admission for museum members and children under 3. Reserve your spot at longmontmuseum.org. Tête De Femme Au Chapeau – Picasso (Image courtesy Longmont Museum)
The Longmont Museum has curated a series of engaging programs designed to enhance the exhibit experience. Highlights include: The Fourth Dimension: A Poetry Reading (Feb. 6) – Celebrate Picasso's artistic exploration through original poetry and readings of Guillaume Apollinaire's works.
(Feb. 6) – Celebrate Picasso's artistic exploration through original poetry and readings of Guillaume Apollinaire's works. Igor Stravinsky's 'L'Histoire du Soldat' (March 20) – A captivating musical theater performance by the Longmont Symphony Orchestra.
(March 20) – A captivating musical theater performance by the Longmont Symphony Orchestra. Erik Satie & All That Jazz (April 3) – Explore the musical melting pot of Picasso's Paris.
In addition to performances, the museum offers interactive art sessions like watercolor and portrait painting inspired by Picasso, as well as thought-provoking talks and film screenings.
Admission to the exhibit is just $8 for adults and $5 for students, seniors, and veterans. Visitors with qualifying EBT or SNAP cards can enter for 25 cents, making it accessible for all.
Located at 400 Quail Road, Longmont, CO, the museum is a cultural gem in Northern Colorado. Whether you're a longtime Picasso admirer or discovering his work for the first time, this exhibit promises an unforgettable experience.

title: How to Beat an Addiction: A Complete Guide
description: This advertising makes North Forty News possible: Overcoming an addiction is a complex journey that requires dedication, support, and practical strategies. No matter the type of substance or behavior,…
content:
Overcoming an addiction is a complex journey that requires dedication, support, and practical strategies. No matter the type of substance or behavior, acknowledging the problem is the first step toward recovery. This guide outlines essential steps and resources that can aid individuals in their journey to a healthier, addiction-free life.
Addiction is often described as a chronic condition characterized by compulsive substance use, despite harmful consequences. It impacts not only the individual but also their loved ones and community. Understanding the nature of addiction can empower individuals to seek help and recognize that they are not alone in their struggles. Many people find themselves trapped in patterns of addiction due to a combination of genetic, environmental, and psychological factors. The cycle of addiction can feel inescapable, leading to feelings of shame and despair. However, understanding that these are common challenges can provide hope for recovery.
Identifying the signs of addiction is crucial for initiating the recovery process. It can manifest in various ways, such as physical symptoms, emotional changes, or shifts in behavior. Common indicators include: – Withdrawal symptoms when not using the substance – Loss of interest in activities once enjoyed – Relationship problems with friends and family – And neglecting responsibilities at work or home By recognizing these signs early, individuals can take proactive steps to confront their addiction and pursue effective treatment options.
Choosing the right treatment center is vital for successful recovery. Treatment centers offer various programs tailored to individual needs, including inpatient, outpatient, and detox services. When looking for help, it's important to consider the specific type of support required. Whether you need addiction treatment in Knoxville, Claxton, or anywhere else, researching local options can lead to significant changes in your life. Look for centers that are accredited and staffed with professionals who understand the nuances of addiction recovery. A supportive environment can make a substantial difference in treatment effectiveness and the overall recovery experience.
A robust support system is fundamental to overcoming addiction. Engaging with family and friends who encourage sobriety can significantly impact recovery. For many, support groups play an essential role in establishing connections with others who share similar experiences. Building a network of individuals who understand addiction can foster a sense of belonging and empowerment. Participation in groups like Alcoholics Anonymous (AA) or Narcotics Anonymous (NA) can provide inspiration and techniques to cope with triggers. Sharing stories and experiences not only validates feelings but also reinforces the commitment to sobriety.
Developing healthy coping strategies is essential for managing stress and avoiding relapse. Individuals in recovery should explore various activities and outlets for their emotions. Mindfulness, meditation, physical exercise, and creative hobbies can serve as positive distractions and help to cultivate resilience in the face of challenges. Learning to recognize triggers and developing plans to manage them is vital. People can develop a more balanced lifestyle that promotes long-term sobriety by substituting good behaviors for toxic ones.
Goal-setting is a powerful motivator that supports sustained recovery efforts. Establishing clear and realistic goals allows individuals to track their progress and celebrate achievements, regardless of size. It's essential to focus on short-term and long-term goals that align with personal values and life aspirations. Encouragement comes from recognizing that setbacks can occur along the journey. Instead of viewing them as failures, it's important to frame them as opportunities for growth and learning. Acknowledging progress is essential in maintaining a positive outlook during the recovery process.
Engaging with mental health professionals can help individuals address underlying issues that contribute to addiction. Therapy options, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) or motivational interviewing, can provide insightful techniques to resolve emotional turmoil and self-destructive patterns. Counselors and therapists equipped to handle addiction can offer personalized strategies that resonate with the individual's unique challenges. Therapy facilitates self-reflection, helping individuals to understand their behaviors better and develop healthier thought processes. Aftercare: Maintaining Sobriety
After completing initial treatment, aftercare plays a crucial role in preventing relapse. Structured aftercare programs allow individuals to transition back into daily life while maintaining sobriety. Regular check-ins, continued therapy, or participation in support groups can provide ongoing motivation. Essentially, the recovery process doesn't end with detoxification or initial treatment. It requires continuous effort, self-care, and community support. A strong aftercare plan significantly improves long-term success in maintaining sobriety.
Beating an addiction involves understanding the problem, recognizing signs, finding the right treatment, and establishing a support network. With realistic goals and professional help, it is possible to overcome addiction and lead a fulfilling life. Engaging in healthy coping mechanisms and committing to aftercare are key aspects of sustaining recovery. The journey may be challenging, but with determination and the right support, recovery is achievable.

title: Plunge Into Winter Fun: Polar Bear Plunge at Horsetooth Reservoir Delights Brave Participants
description: Northern Colorado residents kicked off their snowy weekend with a frosty tradition—the Polar Bear Plunge at Horsetooth Reservoir.
content:
Polar Plunge 2025 at Horsetooth Reservoir (Photo by Larimer County Sheriff's Department)
by Blaine Howerton | NorthFortyNews.com
Northern Colorado residents kicked off their snowy weekend with a frosty tradition—the Polar Bear Plunge at Horsetooth Reservoir. Despite the brisk 36-degree water temperatures, participants gathered at South Bay to embrace the icy challenge and take the plunge.
The event was made possible thanks to the efforts of the Larimer County Emergency Services team, who prepped the area just in time. Equipped with pulaskis and chainsaws, the team cleared paths and created openings in the ice for both the plunge and upcoming ice rescue training by the Larimer County Dive Rescue team. Polar Plunge 2025 at Horsetooth Reservoir (Photo by Larimer County Sheriff's Department)
Safety remained a top priority. Donning high-visibility safety gear, rescue crews ensured the event ran smoothly and provided a reminder about the potential hazards of winter water recreation. While the controlled plunge brought smiles and shivers, the Larimer County Emergency Services team cautioned that such icy waters can turn dangerous quickly for anyone venturing onto unstable ice. Polar Plunge 2025 at Horsetooth Reservoir (Photo by Larimer County Sheriff's Department)
'Always check ice conditions before walking on frozen bodies of water,' the team advised. 'When in doubt, stick to the shoreline.' Polar Plunge 2025 at Horsetooth Reservoir (Photo by Larimer County Sheriff's Department)
For those who prefer staying dry, the Polar Bear Plunge serves as a fun, spectator-friendly way to celebrate winter in Northern Colorado. Whether you took the leap or cheered from the sidelines, it's an event that embodies the adventurous spirit of the region. Polar Plunge 2025 at Horsetooth Reservoir (Photo by Larimer County Sheriff's Department)
As the community thaws out and reflects on the frosty fun, remember to stay safe and stay toasty during your winter adventures!

title: How Online Games are Supporting Local Charities in Colorado

content:
Online gaming has become one of the fastest-growing hobbies over the last decade, transforming from a niche pastime to a multi-billion-dollar industry. Many people consider gaming as an entertainment source, but it is increasingly being seen as a very powerful tool for philanthropy.
In the United States, especially in Colorado, online gaming is becoming a huge avenue for raising funds and awareness for local charities.
From charity gaming tournaments to individual donations, gamers and gaming platforms are stepping up to make a difference in their communities.
The Growing Influence of Online Gaming in Philanthropy
The relationship between online gaming and philanthropy has deepened as technology advances and gaming platforms become more interactive. Many online gaming platforms have realized their potential to mobilize communities toward charitable causes. Whether through organized charity streams, fundraising events, or donation-based competitions, gamers now have more than one way to support local organizations in Colorado. The contributions range from providing essential financial aid to raising awareness about social issues.
Charity Gaming Events Make a Difference
One of the most practical ways that online gaming helps local charities in Colorado is through charity gaming events. Usually, these events are full of gamers and streamers playing games while contributing funds to specific causes. Therefore, the collection is done from donations from viewers, sponsorships, and specific in-game challenges. These include the likes of: Extra Life Fundraising for Children's Hospitals
Extra Life is a very successful endeavor that unites gamers around the globe for a charity stream and raises funds for their local Children's Miracle Network Hospitals in Colorado. Gamers stream marathon-style gaming sessions and invite viewers to contribute their donations.
Over the years, Extra Life has collectively raised millions of dollars for pediatric healthcare and proves that gaming is a pretty positive force. ColoradoPlays Charity Streams
ColoradoPlays is one prominent organization that plans gaming events. At these events, 100 percent of the income goes towards raising funds for various charities, which include food banks, children's hospitals, and many animal shelters in the region. These streams, hence, bridge entertainment to social responsibility through encouragement and donation among those participating in a favorite game.
Besides charity-specific gaming events, online platforms are playing a critical role in enabling and encouraging gamers to contribute to good causes. Some of the platforms have even integrated charitable donation options within their interfaces, making it easier than ever for gamers to give back.
This model of gaming benefits not only the players but also the charities they choose to support. By integrating financial incentives with charitable giving, MPL and similar platforms encourage more gamers to participate in philanthropic efforts.
Local Impact: How Gaming Funds Are Supporting Colorado Communities?
The influence of online gaming charity initiatives is evident in various communities across Colorado. The funds raised through these gaming events and platforms support a range of essential services, including: Healthcare & medical research
For instance, gaming fundraising for Children's Hospital Colorado has already borne fruits, as many programs similar to Extra Life have seen hundreds of thousands and sometimes millions raised toward pediatric research and treatments for desperately needed care on behalf of these children.
